# Melton for Iowa 2026
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2026 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, in between doing some logistics/admin work on the campaign front, I joined those protesting the eminent domain abuse-driven, public health and water access-threatening CO2 pipelines at the Capitol in Des Moines, attended a multi-county party planning event in Britt in Hancock County, and joined up with Fort Dodge Pride at their cookout over the weekend. I also traveled out to Glenwood in Mills County to see my dear friend Candella one last time.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: Candella was my first ever volunteer during my first campaign for Congress. She reached out to me at the very beginning of that campaign in early '22, having seen that I filed. She asked if I knew what I was doing, and at that time, honestly, being an outsider and starting from scratch, I said no. I filed to run because no one else had, and I knew in the age of Trumpism that we couldn't just roll over and give up. She said she didn't know how to campaign either, but was determined to help me figure it out. She was a dynamo, her relentless passion fueling much of that first campaign.

body:
| | | Dear Peter,

My friend Congresswoman Zoe Lofgren is an unsung hero for defending our democracy and our Constitution.

I had not known Zoe well before our work together on the House Select Committee to investigate the January 6th attack on the United States Capitol, but I was aware of her reputation as one of the most effective and respected Members of the House of Representatives. She is a thoughtful and serious member, and she operates with zero ego — a rarity in Congress.

Zoe has been a source of wisdom and good judgment for me and many Members in Congress. Although we don’t share many views on politics or public policy, I can assure you that we need Zoe in Congress and on the frontlines as we continue to protect and secure the future of our democracy.

We all must look beyond party and support people like Zoe who will defend the Constitution, someone we know will do the right thing. _We need good, smart, honest and honorable people in elected office._

Hey Peter, I want to fill you in on something. One of the key parts of my role at the NDRC is reviewing our grassroots fundraising numbers to gauge how strongly we can invest in fighting back against the Trump administration’s attacks on democracy. I’m so proud of this team. For the first few months of this year, supporters like you have stepped up and helped power wins across the country. From staving off a baseless attempt to throw out ballots and overturn a free and fair election in North Carolina to defending our pro-democracy majority on the Wisconsin Supreme Court, even up against a blank check from Elon Musk. Together, we’ve held the line amid a galling assault on our democracy. The truth is, we’ve started to see a decline in our fundraising numbers over the past few weeks. I get it — not everyone is able to contribute every time it’s needed. And I’m so thankful for every donation that comes in, especially these days. **But taking our foot off the gas right now could have a serious impact on our ability to keep up our momentum.** You might not hear about it in the news, but 2025 is an election year with key state-level races up for grabs. And the fair maps movement is working in several states as I write this to stop efforts to weaken our democracy and people’s rights to equal representation. body:
https://www.politivistaction.com [https://www.politivistaction.com]
Hi Peter!
We know it’s been a while since you’ve heard from the Cori Bush team here at Politivist. We’ve missed you.
Instead of filling up your inbox, we’ve been doing what we do best: organizing, listening, and standing with our people.
In fact, we just launched Politivist Power , a new 501(c)(4) organization uniting grassroots organizing with political strategy to fight oppression. Our first campaign, Movement 4 Freedom , [https://www.movement4freedom.com/] is a call to radically transform the implementation of justice, safety, and liberation through love and solidarity. And right now, St. Louis needs us more than ever.
On Friday, our city was hit by a catastrophic tornado—the deadliest since 1959. Entire neighborhoods were torn apart. A reported seven lives lost. Dozens injured. And tens of thousands of homes and businesses damaged or without power.
This is a crisis. Still , through the devastation, we’ve seen our community step up.
The Politivist team is on the ground, providing supplies, checking on families, and showing up for those who’ve been left behind.

This isn’t just about disaster relief—it's about rallying around our neighbors, ensuring no one feels alone, and supporting the kind of leadership rooted in care, compassion, and community. That’s what Politivist Power through Movement 4 Freedom is building and why this work matters.
If you believe in that work, if you believe in us, chip in today. Your contribution fuels everything that we’re doing—right now and in the fights ahead. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/stltornadorelief?refcode=x_250521_politivistpower_act]

If you’d like to give solely to the relief fund, click here to donate directly to community aid efforts. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/action-st-louis?refcode=x_250521_politivistpower_act]
We’ve got a big mission ahead: to elect progressives who lead with love, act with urgency, and fight for every single one of us. And we’re ready to get back to it—with you by our side.
In solidarity,
Politivist Power Inc/Movement 4 Freedom

body:
From dismantling the Department of Ed to funding cuts for SNAP, CHIP, PBS and more, one thing is clear: Our children are under attack.

| | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us8.campaign-archive.com/?e=7e921d898f&i=*|ITERATION_UNIQUE_ID|*&u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=1426de4f5e)
---
| | | Hi Peter,
The world feels like chaos and sometimes I just want to tune out. But when it comes to my kids – and yours – that’s simply not an option.
Right now, a wave of actions are putting our children directly in harm’s way. From trying to slash SNAP and children’s healthcare funding, to dismantling the Department of Education, to tariffs that raise the costs of essentials for our kids, to eliminating a billion dollars in mental health support for schools, to cutting funding for PBS — it’s all adding up.
---
**One thing is clear: These are Kid Cuts.**
| [STAND UP FOR OUR KIDS](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=b56ac3dccc&e=7e921d898f&i=ec48afef7c)
---
| Kids are losing access to the basics they need to grow up healthy, safe, and supported, at a time when the systems are _already_ failing us. That means fewer meals at school. Fewer doctors' visits. Less early learning. And even higher prices on baby formula, toys, and school supplies.
This isn’t just one issue — it’s an all-out attack on childhood, designed to help billionaires and big corporations get even richer. And as parents, we’re not going to stand for it.
[**Click here to Stand Up for Our Kids**](https://parents-together.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1c4af7e0c2cf6603f994addd7&id=63ab2c3c14&e=7e921d898f&i=ec48afef7c) , if you want to join a growing movement of parents fighting back to protect children from these harmful cuts and policies.
---
| | | Thank you for standing up for our kids’ future.**Nani**

Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
NO MAGA BUDGET CUTS:
In D.C. with allies to demand the housing and healthcare we ALL deserve
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Quintero%20DC%20housing%20healthcare.jpg]
Trump's 'one big beautiful bill' [https://www.vox.com/donald-trump/413370/trump-house-big-beautiful-bill-megabill-explained] that Congressional Republicans are shoving through the legislative process is one big mess and betrayal to all who call this country home. Instead of adequately funding our federal government to better serve our everyday needs, the bill is nothing but a MAGA tax break 'love letter' to out-of-touch billionaires, prioritizing them over our families.
TOP members from across the state are in Washington D.C. this week advocating with our partners at Popular Democracy in Action to call out the drastic cuts to Medicaid and federal housing assistance in Trump's budget proposal.
WATCH this video clip of today's rally for housing. [https://www.facebook.com/watch/live/?ref=watch_permalink&v=1204778770765498&rdid=H42Jp3a3HF6t5JmW]
Make no mistake, these massive budget cuts will be disastrous for working families already struggling to make ends meet. Along with nationwide allies, we will keep fighting and hold accountable the MAGA Republicans in support of this ridiculous billionaire handout.
NEXT SATURDAY:
Drop by TOP's probation campaign launch in San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Gavel-Scales-of-Justice.jpg]
More people are on probation in Texas than are serving time in every county jail -- that's 254 counties put together and then multiplied by three. In Bexar County alone, one in 64 adults are under supervision.
Latino and Black Texans disproportionately face a financial burden on probation due to a combination of factors, including high probation fees, and the added cost of other financial obligations such as drug testing costs, restitution payments, and dependent support mandates. These added costs further strain the financial resources of fellow community members already struggling to make ends meet, leading to our existing probation system being a costly driver of mass incarceration.
JOIN TOP next Saturday, May 31, from 11 a.m. - 2 p.m. at the Barbara Jordan Community Center in San Antonio for food and bingo fun as we launch our probation campaign in Bexar County!
RSVP @ toptx.us/bingo [https://secure.everyaction.com/Tw10BpOCS0mgSyDcXMcmzQ2]
Together, let's fight for a local probation system that works fairly for EVERYONE that focuses rehabilitation and humane community-based solutions.
For more information on this event, email Michael Nachebe ( mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] ) and Laquita Garcia ( lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] ).
RSVP NOW:
Speak out for fair and equitable disaster recovery in Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Hurricane%20Beryl%20flooding%20.jpg]
Were you impacted by Hurricane Beryl or last year’s Derecho storm? If so, we want to hear from you! Make your voice heard in Houston’s process to spend federal disaster recovery funds.
JOIN TOP and community allies on May 31 from 11 a.m. to 1 p.m. at the Harris County Pct. 1 Admin. & Service Center for FREE community resources and to learn how you can be better prepared when severe weather strikes.
Register for the town hall here. [https://secure.everyaction.com/RbWscnc1gE2YSseD35hYLg2]
Contact TOP's Irie Howard at ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] to learn more about the event.
Calling out a ridiculous Republican redistricting ploy in Tarrant County
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Redistricting%20Tarrant%20County%202025.jpg]
A Texas GOP power grab is underway in the third most populated county in the state -- Tarrant County. Read about it here. [https://www.nbcdfw.com/news/local/tarrant-county-redistricting-process/3834605/]
This underhanded plan to redraw commissioners' precinct boundaries is partisan to its core, as it's a direct attempt to dillute the voting power of Black and Latino communities, as well as a rushed effort to oust progressive Tarrant County Commissioner Alisa Simmons of Pct. 2. It's clear-cut racial gerrymandering.
TOP was in attendance at a packed town hall in Arlington this past Saturday [https://www.keranews.org/government/2025-05-17/tarrant-county-redistricting-arlington-alisa-simmons] , where dozens of community members spoke up to denounce this blatant political move.
We'll continue to monitor this racist redistricting push as it unfolds.
TOP Tip: Hurricane season is almost here. Make sure you're stocked up.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hurricane.jpg]
With extreme weather continuing to escalate due to climate change, it's never a bad time to check you have some basic supplies handy in the case of severe weather. Hurricane season officially starts June 1. View a checklist of emergency kit items to have at home. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/graphics/2024/05/01/how-to-stay-safe-from-hurricanes-preparation-tips-and-disaster-plans/73515320007/]

NO A LOS RECORTES PRESUPUESTARIOS DE MAGA:
En Washington D.C. con aliados para exigir la vivienda y la atención médica que TODOS merecemos
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Quintero%20DC%20housing%20healthcare.jpg]
El “gran y hermoso proyecto de ley” de Trump [https://www.vox.com/donald-trump/413370/trump-house-big-beautiful-bill-megabill-explained] , que los republicanos en el Congreso están imponiendo a toda prisa en el proceso legislativo, es un verdadero desastre y una traición para todas las personas que llaman hogar a este país. En lugar de financiar adecuadamente a nuestro gobierno federal para que sirva mejor a nuestras necesidades diarias, este proyecto de ley no es más que una “carta de amor” de recortes fiscales estilo MAGA para multimillonarios desconectados de la realidad, priorizándolos por encima de nuestras familias.
Esta semana, miembros de TOP de todo el estado están en Washington D.C. junto a nuestras/os aliadas/os de Popular Democracy in Action, alzando la voz en contra de los recortes drásticos a Medicaid y a la asistencia federal para vivienda incluidos en la propuesta de presupuesto de Trump.
MIRA este video del mitin de hoy en defensa de la vivienda. [https://www.facebook.com/watch/live/?ref=watch_permalink&v=1204778770765498&rdid=hYg9v6R0oDtdYhzs]
Que no quede duda: estos recortes masivos al presupuesto serían desastrosos para las familias trabajadoras que ya están batallando para salir adelante. J unto a aliadas/os en todo el país, seguiremos luchando y exigiendo rendición de cuentas a los republicanos MAGA que apoyan esta ridícula entrega de dinero a los multimillonarios.
PRÓXIMO SÁBADO:
Visite el lanzamiento de la campaña de libertad condicional de TOP en San Antonio
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Gavel-Scales-of-Justice.jpg]
En Texas, hay más personas en libertad condicional que personas encarceladas en todas las cárceles de los 254 condados -- ¡multiplicado por tres! Solo en el Condado de Bexar, uno de cada 64 adultos está bajo supervisión.
Las y los texanos latinos y morenos enfrentan desproporcionadamente una carga económica en el sistema de libertad condicional debido a varios factores, incluyendo las altas tarifas mensuales, los costos de pruebas de drogas, pagos de restitución y mandatos de apoyo a dependientes. Estos costos adicionales aumentan la presión sobre miembros de la comunidad que ya batallan para llegar a fin de mes, convirtiendo al sistema actual de libertad condicional en un motor costoso de encarcelamiento masivo.
¡ÚNETE A TOP el próximo sábado 31 de mayo de 11 a.m. a 2 p.m. en el Centro Comunitario Barbara Jordan en San Antonio para disfrutar comida, lotería y el lanzamiento de nuestra campaña sobre libertad condicional en el Condado de Bexar!
Confirme su asistencia en toptx.us/bingo [https://secure.everyaction.com/Tw10BpOCS0mgSyDcXMcmzQ2] .
Juntos, luchemos por un sistema local de libertad condicional que funcione de manera justa para TODOS y que se centre en la rehabilitación y las soluciones comunitarias humanas.
Para más información sobre este evento, escriba a Michael Nachebe ( mnachebe@organizetexas.org [mnachebe@organizetexas.org] ) y Laquita García ( lgarcia@organizetexas.org [lgarcia@organizetexas.org] ).
RSVP AHORA:
Promueva una recuperación justa y equitativa ante desastres en Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Houston%20Hurricane%20Beryl%20flooding%20.jpg]
¿Fuiste afectado por el huracán Beryl o la tormenta Derecho del año pasado? ¡Si es así, queremos escucharte! Haz que tu voz se escuche en el proceso de Houston para decidir cómo se gastarán los fondos federales de recuperación por desastres.
ÚNETE a TOP y a nuestras organizaciones aliadas este 31 de mayo de 11 a.m. a 1 p.m. en el Centro Administrativo y de Servicios del Precinto 1 del Condado de Harris para acceder a recursos comunitarios GRATUITOS y aprender cómo estar mejor preparado cuando llegue el mal clima.
Regístrate para el foro comunitario aquí. [https://secure.everyaction.com/RbWscnc1gE2YSseD35hYLg2]
Comunícate con Irie Howard de TOP en ihoward@organizetexas.org [ihoward@organizetexas.org] para obtener más información sobre el evento.
Condenando una ridicula estratagema republicana de redistribución de distritos en el condado de Tarrant
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Redistricting%20Tarrant%20County%202025.jpg]
El Partido Republicano de Texas está llevando a cabo una toma de poder en el tercer condado más poblado del estado: el Condado de Tarrant. Lee más sobre esto aquí. [https://www.nbcdfw.com/news/local/tarrant-county-redistricting-process/3834605/]
Este plan tramposo para redefinir los límites de los distritos de los comisionados es profundamente partidista, ya que busca diluir el poder del voto de las comunidades morenas y latinas, además de ser un intento apresurado por sacar del cargo a la comisionada progresista del Precinto 2, Alisa Simmons. Esto es un claro ejemplo de manipulación racial de distrito.
TOP estuvo presente este sábado pasado en un foro comunitario lleno a tope en Arlington [https://www.keranews.org/government/2025-05-17/tarrant-county-redistricting-arlington-alisa-simmons] , donde docenas de miembros de la comunidad alzaron la voz para denunciar esta jugada política descarada.
Seguiremos monitoreando de cerca este intento racista de redistritación mientras se desarrolla.
Consejos de TOP: La temporada de huracanes ya casi llega. Asegúrate de tener provisiones.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Hurricane.jpg]
Con el aumento de eventos climáticos extremos debido al cambio climático, nunca está de más revisar que tengas suministros básicos a la mano en caso de clima severo. La temporada de huracanes comienza oficialmente el 1 de Junio. Consulte una lista de artículos para el kit de emergencias que debe tener en casa. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/graphics/2024/05/01/how-to-stay-safe-from-hurricanes-preparation-tips-and-disaster-plans/73515320007/]

# **A Miscarraige of Justice in Judge Banfield's Courtroom**
**Bellevue** —Judge Camara Banfield ruled in favor of the Defense's Motion for summary judgement this week in Frohlich v. Clark. This sets the effective precedent that county auditors are under no legal obligation to remove voters from the voter rolls who have previously reported moving to the government or even updating their voter registrations prior to an election. Counting the votes of these voters from their previous addresses and allowing them to impact races for which they are no longer constituents has been clarified to be Washington State law. While the ruling is an obvious miscarriage of justice, and moreover the current construction of the law is broken, it is not the end of our fight - not even close.

The ruling of this case going against the Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP) presents a larger opportunity to tackle the flaws of our election system by clarifying where the current interpretation of state law could potentially contradict higher levels of law. While we are still looking over and considering all the current legal interpretations, we are confident this ruling will allow us to file follow-up lawsuits with more favorable courts that could lead to WA state election law, as interpreted and as written, being ruled unconstitutional.

Please consider contributing to WAGOP to help us fight back on all fronts. When everything is broken and going against us, we cannot give up; we must find new strategies that work and fight for what is right. Well-crafted legal strategies and carefully articulated arguments are two of our primary means of fighting back. Our Constitution was written to protect us in times when tyrants function as if they rule over us. They DO NOT. Help us send them this message. [We are grateful for your support.](https://wsrp.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=be1a8605f1118163852707f35&id=0531d4651b&e=6a281f566d) Thank you.

Sincerely,

This sets the effective precedent that county auditors are under no legal obligation to remove voters from the voter rolls who have previously reported moving to the government or even updating their voter registrations prior to an election. Counting the votes of these voters from their previous addresses and allowing them to impact races for which they are no longer constituents has been clarified to be Washington State law. While the ruling is an obvious miscarriage of justice, and moreover the current construction of the law is broken, it is not the end of our fight - not even close. The ruling of this case going against the Washington State Republican Party (WAGOP) presents a larger opportunity to tackle the flaws of our election system by clarifying where the current interpretation of state law could potentially contradict higher levels of law. While we are still looking over and considering all the current legal interpretations, we are confident this ruling will allow us to file follow-up lawsuits with more favorable courts that could lead to WA state election law, as interpreted and as written, being ruled unconstitutional. Please consider contributing to WAGOP to help us fight back on all fronts. name: Hillsdale College via 1600 Daily
subject: The greatest armed conflict in human history
body:
This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict

This sponsored message from 1600 Daily is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zuuv7nmr6h9oguqa20mpu8rllfnuqiu8l5sqcri8_rp22sh2s8i6eob7cjg61o35c9h2bs) Dear Fellow American,
Only a fraction of the 16 million Americans who fought bravely in World War II remain with us. This fact means that we’re losing more and more living memory of the greatest armed conflict in human history, which makes the study of World War II even more important.
To this end, Hillsdale College has produced an online course called **“The Second World Wars.”**
**Taught by historian Victor Davis Hanson** , this course explores how the conflict’s diverse theaters, belligerents, and ways of fighting came eventually to define a single war. And it examines the key investments, strategies, and leaders that led the Allied powers to victory over the Axis. Here’s a secure link to reserve your copy of **“The Second World Wars”** on DVD:
**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-the-second-world-wars](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z84pvrdiat11p8dtrvq6sgf1m78b90cdr9u8uf8g_rp22sh2s8i6eob7cjg61o35c9h2bs)**
Thank you for preserving liberty for future generations of Americans through education with Hillsdale College!
Best regards,
Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D. Executive Director of Online Learning Hillsdale College

name: James O'Keefe
subject: Our culture has a sick hatred for integrity and achievement
body:
I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement and wishes to destroy anyone willing to challenge the status quo

|
---
| | [](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zs3m0egclj3k0c9i3ptd5bnl0dnucm500bd8cft0_rp22sh2s8i6eob7cji68or2c1h2bs) Friend,

I learned firsthand how our culture despises achievement and wishes to destroy anyone willing to challenge the status quo, big government, or the Fake News media machine.

When I was ousted from Project Veritas, two big things (one you haven't heard about) happened to me.

FIRST: The media launched a vicious smear campaign against me like I've never seen before. **Make no mistake:** _They identified this as an opportunity to "cancel" me forever_ and tried everything in their power to destroy me and everything I've ever stood for.

They failed.

SECOND: I received an OVERWHELMING amount of support from patriots across the country. These brave men and women defended me, but more importantly, they stood up for the principles of liberty and free speech.

**One of my top supporters was The Atlas Society.**

Jennifer Grossman, the CEO of The Atlas Society, proudly stood by my side and even invited me to speak with a gathering of the organization's top student leaders about free speech and how Howard Roark, the fictional hero of _The Fountainhead_ by Ayn Rand, remains my inspiration to act with integrity.

Which is why I am personally reaching out to you.

I told Jennifer I would help The Atlas Society raise $25,000 in the next 48 hours by personally contacting my online supporters. [Please consider making an URGENT donation of any amount to The Atlas Society by clicking here.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zpe8k3eib019p2fv85uu183dmfmuuq7ms8tr0280_rp22sh2s8i6eob7cji68or2c1h2bs)

Let me tell you more about The Atlas Society and how they are fundamentally changing the direction of our country.

_I will also tell you HOW The Atlas Society is spreading its message in what I consider one of the most innovative methods I 've EVER seen a nonprofit organization engage in before._

_**_So keep reading_!**_

My mentor, Andrew Breitbart, reminds us that politics is downstream from culture. But what is culture downstream from? Answer: Philosophy. That's where The Atlas Society shines, engaging young people with the virtues of reason, achievement, and benevolent self-interest in wildly creative, artistic ways.

Have you ever read Ayn Rand's _Atlas Shrugged_ or _The Fountainhead_?

These books changed how I saw the world and my role in it.

But they are 700+ pages long!

**Jennifer shared this terrifying statistic with me:** Daily reading of books among young people has fallen from 70% in the late 1970s to 12% today.

So, how do we preserve Rand's role as the greatest all-time recruiter for liberty? That's where The Atlas Society gets creative! They leverage art and technology to create programming for "_skimmers, swimmers, and deep divers_."
**Skimmers:** Social media memes and animated videos -- every single one of their 50 posts a week gets 40K comments, shares, and likes. The "Draw My Life" videos on concepts like Capitalism, Property Rights, and Free Speech reach MILLIONS of viewers. Links invite young people on a journey for deeper intellectual exploration.

**Swimmers:** Graphic novel adaptations of Ayn Rand's shorter books, Pocket Guides that distill big concepts like Postmodernism and Socialism into a 90-minute read. Weekly podcasts with top entrepreneurs and thought-leaders, and discussion groups like "Morals & Markets."

**Deep Divers:** They recruited an all-star academic faculty of philosophers and economists who guide students on a deeper study of Rand's philosophy, publish independent work, and provide programming at their summer conference for students (the Galt's Gulch Summit, where I spoke!).
Jennifer and The Atlas Society are accomplishing great things for our country, and I hope you will be one of the FIRST supporters of mine to make a donation and help me reach our $25,000 goal. Please use one of these links to donate:

Ultimately, here is what The Atlas Society is fighting FOR:
* Free market capitalism
* Rational self-interest
* Respect for achievement and success
* Free speech
* The future of young people and our great country

And here is what The Atlas Society is fighting AGAINST:
* Cancel Culture
* Our Educational system indoctrinating young people to embrace socialism
* Our sick culture that demonizes success and embraces twisted ideas
* Big government

I am inviting you to support The Atlas Society with a donation of ANY amount.

As a personal favor to me, please make your donation within the next 48 hours so I can help Jennifer reach our goal of $25,000.

[Here is the link to donate one more time.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zgcn24ffai6qvrcpj80gvbok3c8l3la0qm6j4v6g_rp22sh2s8i6eob7cji68or2c1h2bs)

Thank you for everything,

James O'Keefe

P.S. Here is a picture of me speaking with The Atlas Society's top student leaders.

Well, NOT these students.

The Atlas Society is teaching students that they CAN accomplish great things, become leaders, and inspire others to do the same.

James

We need your voice to help stop this big, bad budget bill
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3612032/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
| **🚨****MAJOR UPDATE:** The House of Representatives just passed the disastrous Republican budget bill to advance President Trump’s agenda.

We must do everything we can to urge the Senate to protect vital programs and clean energy tax credits that Americans depend on. **Email your senators right now.** [TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3612033/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Friend—

The House just passed Trump’s “one big, beautiful bill” (_more like_** _“big, bad billionaire bill”_**) and there’s nothing beautiful about it. That’s because it’s an **aggressive repeal of the Inflation Reduction Act (IRA) clean energy programs** we fought so hard to win, not to mention **an assault on working families across America** who depend on the lifesaving programs the House just voted to cut.

While the news is disappointing, **our fight is far from over.** The next stop for this bill is the Senate, where Republicans are expected to try to rush a vote through before most Americans even know what’s happening.

That means **this moment is critical** for putting pressure on senators who might still be persuaded, and for reminding senators who already oppose it to hold strong and not give an inch. [**Will you do your part and send your senators a message right now?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3612034/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[EMAIL YOUR SENATORS](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3612035/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Let’s be extra clear about what will happen if the budget bill passes and gets signed by Trump: **Everyday working Americans are going to lose more of their hard-earned money just so billionaires can get massive tax breaks.**

Here are some specific impacts we can anticipate: |
---
|
* The price of gasoline could increase by 37 cents per gallon—over $200 per year for the average gas vehicle. Costs for new electric vehicles will go up by $7,500, plus a $250 annual fee.
* Electricity costs for American households could go up by more than $110 in 2026.
* Skyrocketing insurance premiums will get even worse, and more people will lose their homes due to the worsening climate crisis.
* $300 billion will get gutted from the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP), which currently helps over 42 million people across the country afford groceries.
* And more outlined in [our recent blog.](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3612036/87SdQ4wZ)

|
---
| **📣 We need Evergreen advocates like you to show up in this moment to make sure that our voices are heard and that our senators understand who they work for.**

Otherwise, the next federal budget could cut vital support for households across the country, put unnecessary financial stress on working Americans, and take a sledgehammer to hard-won climate progress—just so Donald Trump can make payouts to the billionaire cronies that funded his campaign.

[**Don’t wait, friend. Email your senators right now and urge them to fight for you by voting NO on the GOP budget bill.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/3612037/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
| Thanks for your continued advocacy, |
---
| | |
---
### Lena Moffitt
Executive Director
Evergreen Action

## FDA Puts Restrictions on COVID Vaccines
The FDA has announced it will limit [future COVID-19 booster shots to Americans over 65](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGOszAQBOCnMZ2RWWObFC5-6Re6JtdeiTb2AntncIQtorz9KXmFq0cazTdf1-mKnHhfPnEjX-c87fQoiWqlYwr55HhiCLxT4o1r2WjLB-MECoxURgJMETk9p76JfiYC0g35zvXuoobedM3q8dK5AdUMg9FGRWsJuziEm5mDmq2lhv2rTRmATimnVXtDiu7S2R6Ds1Zr0SuKXPPRfmfe60pzeuaTjjbkrUl-rfVehP4nYBQw4i28BO2SX7GA8YMw1VXAOEeU94R7kW-LfOtkWXMt0hq58rLKg8uPgLHUfDyFHjkK_b8DUFoNg2sOH-8PTomLdaJXy4ac3iPqn547PfwGAAD__4JkgVo) and those with high-risk medical conditions, effectively ending universal annual recommendations and reducing eligibility to roughly one-third of the population. Officials said routine boosters are no longer justified for healthy individuals unless vaccine makers conduct new placebo-controlled trials—a requirement companies argue is unrealistic due to the rapid evolution of viral variants. At the same time, the FDA has expanded warning labels on Pfizer and Moderna’s mRNA vaccines to reflect a [higher risk of myocarditis and pericarditis](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJyk0DGOtDAMBeDThC4omECgSPE3dPO3WyKTmMGrQEZJBJrbrxjtDbazZOk9fe_rMT-QAx_P_7iTLWucD7pyoFIozS6e7E90jg8KvHPJO-0xMc6goJOqkwCzRw7vWVferkRAbUW2MdqMatBdU20WhlUZTWbQOBqnGmqHcdEGQCvXNp2p2N5pqgNolDKtqhckb8am1-hM37et0Io8l5jq78hH2WgN73hSql3cq2C3Ul5ZtP8ETAKm67pqt-Rbcf8FTPcpYFo9yg9I_orkng6UG2EqMrMnSetKrmR5YTr4eMqACwUBU5Wsf10cAufeCK2eO3L4lJc_LXZa-AkAAP__j8-AQA)—heart inflammation—particularly in males aged 16 to 25. The update follows new agency data and long-term follow-up studies. Separately, a Senate report led by Sen. Ron Johnson accuses Biden administration health officials of [delaying public warnings about these risks](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkD2O3DAMhU8jdxzItMeOChVp3G3alAYt0TPM6seQtDPw7QMvcoM0bAh8773v98f6QRIkPX5RZNv2vCZ-18CtcVldfol_kXOSOEiUViPHXIRW1HgHfQfE1ZOEcx07b3dm5KFj28_jbPSP8d53T7shE_p52rZpGs1oHBomt_d68Ngbg53Yi6bviL3W86BvG7GfTT-N5OZpGgY1avbScrn9yZLak_dw5heXm8uxC_bZ2lHV8FPhonBJ55Fru14KlwuscNHXwV7h8lXh2qdw2cRzgrzv4oRChc_Eb6AtfzXw-Z2OQCd7iGd2VLw0qVCkflbYS47wLQZ6A__kVKicqDEUPnJpQCHwg6-Yrlh_vCUEqdOsRv2IJOG7ePsv2y-LfwMAAP__6JqVXA) in 2021, despite early alerts from Israeli authorities and the Pentagon.
## Record Travel Expected for Memorial Day Weekend
AAA projects a record-breaking [45.1 million Americans will travel](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJykkMFuwyAQRL8G32zBgiE5cKhU-ZZeqqpHawPrZFtsIowc-e8rV_2Dnkeamfc-L-MFOfFye8OZfJ3yuNBzTVQrlTHkjeOGIfBCiWeu60xzLowjSOhb2bcAY0RO-2ia6CciIN2QV864szyZXjV3rwmjjEZb53prcdJk9SkqsnYyhFI27I822QMoKZ2W3RUpurOyBoOzVmthJEWuuXRfmZd6pynteaPShTw3yd9rfaxCvwgYBAx4DQdBd8tHLGD4eBcw_P1ObcS9fRJ90xLbWnCj1E65UMC1ChjWmssu9MBR6FcFykkLFpri4-PJKfFqnTDyNiOn3_H6L2Obh58AAAD__4VXftk) at least 50 miles from home for Memorial Day weekend 2025 (May 22–26), surpassing the 2005 record of 44 million. Road trips dominate, with 39.4 million people planning to drive, up 1 million from 2024, fueled by lower gas prices averaging $3.14 per gallon nationally compared to $3.59 last year. Air travel is expected to see 3.61 million passengers, a 2% increase from last year, though domestic flights are 2% pricier, averaging $850 for a round-trip ticket. Cruises, especially to Alaska destinations like Fairbanks and Juneau, are also surging, with AAA noting 2 million Americans are planning travel by ship, train, or bus this weekend. body:
Have you read about President Biden's Ambassador to the United Nations?

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/OlYfgv0CmAVPbZIf1taRJA~~/AARclBA~/uGKyTaY1ILXDvirWE5fs7Hopnd5o_uSlB-wTMoSNAHmWtW7ki9bqSdOHUpU46XN0xi96fBZrEMs4DWMpK7oF-LckumRharVOT0WqVGwV03jLwxmEWaeHSZ6r1f5Pu8bpyf11ozcNfeKLG3w8BSQNwi9elIxYEolFLW2eg9B83_K9fmz88Ppf-c2Py23qLDwdo0LMc7ZxGEXwsoW2GxK8egx22NF28BWp7h-uIu67jl54p6zoFhKmZAtt6I6pEtIoSgVE0RwrLzxoVf_PHPqCpGFzskIlOpZ7t-yDhcwnunZPMEi2OBLFn_Q2XDYUG33_vsCVL-ZRbJInKhZ7jjwJyw~~) Dear Fellow American, Have you read about President Biden's Ambassador to the United Nations? She is telling her fellow ambassadors from around the world that "white supremacy" is "weaved into [America's] founding documents and principles." Can you imagine being told that America's glorious founding principle--the principle that "all men are created equal," endowed by God with "unalienable rights"--embodies the idea of white supremacy? Can you imagine being told the same thing about our cherished **Constitution** , which is responsible for America becoming the freest, most prosperous nation in human history? That America's United Nations Ambassador is promoting these lies is reprehensible. But even more reprehensible is the fact that so many K-12 and college students in America are being taught this same false narrative. Too many young Americans are not learning what makes America an exceptional nation and a beacon of liberty for the world. Instead, they learn that our great nation's history is essentially a history of injustice--that America at its heart has **always** been racist and is undeserving of respect. Is it any wonder that so many younger Americans today feel an increasing attraction to so-called "critical race theory" and other ideas destructive of liberty? Is it any wonder that there is decreasing support among younger Americans for basic liberties that past generations have revered and taken for granted--liberties such as freedom of speech? It is easy to become discouraged by the Left's dominance in our colleges and universities and its increasing influence in K-12 education. But we must not lose hope--we must fight back with the truth. **Hillsdale College has been engaging the Left on the battlefield of education from the beginning. ** In fact, we produced a free online course that helps do just that, titled **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope."** And I'm asking for your help in promoting it to additional millions of Americans--especially younger Americans--and to expand our other critical outreach efforts on behalf of liberty nationwide. You can help fund the promotion of this important course at this secure link: _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-great-american-story-dvd](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/OlYfgv0CmAVPbZIf1taRJA~~/AARclBA~/uGKyTaY1ILXDvirWE5fs7Hopnd5o_uSlB-wTMoSNAHmWtW7ki9bqSdOHUpU46XN0xi96fBZrEMs4DWMpK7oF-LckumRharVOT0WqVGwV03jLwxmEWaeHSZ6r1f5Pu8bpyf11ozcNfeKLG3w8BSQNwi9elIxYEolFLW2eg9B83_K9fmz88Ppf-c2Py23qLDwdo0LMc7ZxGEXwsoW2GxK8egx22NF28BWp7h-uIu67jl54p6zoFhKmZAtt6I6pEtIoSgVE0RwrLzxoVf_PHPqCpGFzskIlOpZ7t-yDhcwnunZPMEi2OBLFn_Q2XDYUG33_vsCVL-ZRbJInKhZ7jjwJyw~~)**_ [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/OlYfgv0CmAVPbZIf1taRJA~~/AARclBA~/uGKyTaY1ILXDvirWE5fs7Hopnd5o_uSlB-wTMoSNAHmWtW7ki9bqSdOHUpU46XN0xi96fBZrEMs4DWMpK7oF-LckumRharVOT0WqVGwV03jLwxmEWaeHSZ6r1f5Pu8bpyf11ozcNfeKLG3w8BSQNwi9elIxYEolFLW2eg9B83_K9fmz88Ppf-c2Py23qLDwdo0LMc7ZxGEXwsoW2GxK8egx22NF28BWp7h-uIu67jl54p6zoFhKmZAtt6I6pEtIoSgVE0RwrLzxoVf_PHPqCpGFzskIlOpZ7t-yDhcwnunZPMEi2OBLFn_Q2XDYUG33_vsCVL-ZRbJInKhZ7jjwJyw~~) Historian and Hillsdale professor Wilfred McClay teaches the course based on his published history of America. **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** presents a full, unbiased account of America's past. Our goal in producing and promoting this free online course is to **restore the kind of intelligent patriotism --especially among our young people--that is essential to preserving free government.** This work is the surest means of defending liberty--which is why we make every online course available **free of charge** to any citizen wishing to learn. **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"** is a powerful counterweight to _The New York Times_ ' "1619 Project," which seeks to inject the idea that America is essentially unjust into the curricula of America's K-12 schools. Of course, producing an online course and making it available free of charge requires significant resources--and promoting the course nationwide, which is essential, costs even more. To date, more than 118,000 Americans have enrolled in **" The Great American Story: A Land of Hope"**--but we must do more. Your support is critical to our success. As you may know, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student loans and grants. That's why we can remain true to our mission on behalf of liberty, free of so many bureaucratic regulations that burden other colleges and universities. This independence also means that all of our work is entirely dependent on the support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. This is especially true of our national outreach efforts, including free online courses. **Can I count on you today to help fund the promotion of "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope" to millions of Americans nationwide and expand our other educational outreach efforts with a generous tax-deductible gift of $100 or more? ** Please make your best tax-deductible gift using this secure link: _**[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-great-american-story-dvd](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/OlYfgv0CmAVPbZIf1taRJA~~/AARclBA~/uGKyTaY1ILXDvirWE5fs7Hopnd5o_uSlB-wTMoSNAHmWtW7ki9bqSdOHUpU46XN0xi96fBZrEMs4DWMpK7oF-LckumRharVOT0WqVGwV03jLwxmEWaeHSZ6r1f5Pu8bpyf11ozcNfeKLG3w8BSQNwi9elIxYEolFLW2eg9B83_K9fmz88Ppf-c2Py23qLDwdo0LMc7ZxGEXwsoW2GxK8egx22NF28BWp7h-uIu67jl54p6zoFhKmZAtt6I6pEtIoSgVE0RwrLzxoVf_PHPqCpGFzskIlOpZ7t-yDhcwnunZPMEi2OBLFn_Q2XDYUG33_vsCVL-ZRbJInKhZ7jjwJyw~~)**_ We deeply appreciate your partnership in promoting the kind of intelligent patriotism--especially among younger Americans--that is essential to preserving free government. Warm regards, Larry P. ## Paxton Investigating U.S. Masters Swimming
Attorney General Ken Paxton has launched an investigation into U.S. Masters Swimming (USMS) after a [biological male who identifies as female won five women’s events](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0D2u2zAQBODTSN0aJCVRzwWLNO5e2pTCylxKRPhjcPdJ9u0D-wqpBxh8M3--l2-MKZbtN2Zy8gx1KXRyIhFqi9THiuurYCa-76m2WGhDTrQYZSZQExizeIzptYy9d6vyV92T0_M4X7W216nfnV29UmGws8UwmFHRQDjNaO9flnww1z66d5majNFa6WG4DDjpidCi1av6QtuNinyU2i6yk9ATOaRXPahd7jX3ye0iD-6GX525deZ2nucl1Od7xTvvzI0ftQl35vbDkJGFGgOfMedYNvgpnhrEchBL3FBiLYBBqIE0LAwoeyIhEPxLDCEeBGfNVBi2mjxk8pgYPiqgg4r0zfnHGVOKbOduVFvGmD5S-b9_D2f-BQAA__-FDpT_) at the organization’s Spring Nationals meet in San Antonio last month. Ana Caldas, 47, whose original name is Hugo, won gold in the women's age 45-49 category in [each of the events](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQRp8GuolsE8NSUGyT7m67JRrwBEbxD2ImcfL2q3tfYetP39HR-fs1fyFHztsfTDTp-17mTFUiqdI5azkWXD4ZE8m6x3Jypg0l0uyM82A8ODcH5PiZr22YFhNG29Jkh-swWtuPvt0n4xczYvAWx-7uApoeu2Vw4W7C4GzwLU_fMOOds9bYrrt06K0n7LG3i_mFfXM1FFjLedGdlN4o9_gpLzova0ltnHbVQ5rud-NujbvVWi_lqQ9eH997425ylFOlcbefL-AGD8pw4FtLhojPvO4kwPlForyhcsnwFEgoSqeAVE6J8wZ153WHSAoJM6wlHaQEtSTKAvSirNKeUzgqx8jSD83VbAk5_mjq_8V9Te5fAAAA__96ZJOg) the swimmer competed in. USMS allows swimmers to participate in the gender competition category in which they identify. Paxton has requested records to determine if USMS has violated state consumer protection laws by engaging in “false, deceptive and misleading acts and practices.” [In a statement](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkb2upDAMhZ8GOo9I-JmhoNhmurvtlsgQA9E6CYrNMPP2K67uG2x7ZH-frfPna_xCzz6uvzHQoO8ljZFOYVKlPGraJ5w-EQPJvHHKPtKKwjTayrZQtWDt6NDzZ2xKN0yV601Jg7k3996Yrm_LbZhmW3d1b1qaH52bp9YsZKflgc390fXdUvrhglWttcZUpq5vNbamJeywM1P1wK5oKnJeU77pRkpvlIU_6UX5NqdQ8rCp7lLUvwr7LOzzOr8RjBg1RZ-umZ-0sE9OM3Jhnz6-SNSvqD5FYDzivJEDXNFHUTgEAopSFpDTh-DjCpcQkJlWcvwBzRhlpeiuVDcmJfimw6WCSJghEMzZBwLGE_ZjYj-D4EL6sy70PpDhTAEjyJ6yCmg-wg5_KcKOb02xzIPbT8_spbsXTbUG9Pz9uP5fXa_B_gsAAP__rYSzQg), he called the organization’s transgender policy “reprehensible” and “insulting to female athletes.” Texas has banned biological males from competing in women’s sports at the high school and college levels. In February, President Trump [issued an executive order](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDFuhDAQRU9jOiOPsSEULtLQbdqUaIABrBgb4dn17u2jzRXSf_339L5v4w198HH7woMcP9c0Rio5EDNdI6dzwukV8aA87yFdPtKGOdColbZSWan1uKAPr9FUi5vU0kNFDjrT9QBtb6vdgVoNzpNpjJmtJQCaAdS6TC307do1lXfvM2W1BlDQNHWDFixhiy1M6gNbYRQtntNV805MT8xreKUHXfWcjiq4nfnMovkUehB6KKXUZfdMe7pnqrf0EHo4L8p-ocgeg8SZfYpZ6OENFnpQWujhh-j0cZMHRZnuLNMqSzooZpnPdPF7Xl1uOYsPwee2E0ZtB_rwJ8H_S_dw-jcAAP___O2DqA) withholding public funding from educational institutions that allow males to compete in women’s sports.
## LNG Fueling Facility Approved
The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers and the Coast Guard have approved construction of a $300 million liquefied natural gas (LNG) facility in Texas City. It's projected to be the [first marine bunker on the Gulf Coast](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkM2KpDAURp9Gd5EkmmgtspgZRjdVxcAw1FKuetUwMZHk1o9v31RDP0EvPz44HM7t0l_AOuuXK2xo6DWH3uMzOSTC2FPYBxgODxumcXUhWo8LJIe95FIxrpiU_QTWHX2VT2bg00nkaERd1Sch9Enlq4FG1gKqUXANc6lLHAeNqtEg1AwNlLk1bxhXUgrBRVkWJSihEDRoMfAGdFZxnCyFWNCKhC9IszvCA2Mxhi13ZiXaU1b-yGSbyTZYt0c74vvMZHsGwkTst8e4HOyKz5TJ9haim75GB-6BiYJnHVJirY2J2PnasZ93_x-j9Qv7g3GzxIJn__6y7u5m9itAomKlzeXRTPvTOmeTrrOKLxtY92lG3-v5MPIjAAD__3L-i78) to provide the alternative fuel option. Galveston LNG Bunker Port (GLBP) is a project of Houston-based Pilot LNG and Seapath, a subsidiary of New York-based Libra Group. Upon completion in the second half of 2027, the facility is expected to [produce 720,000 gallons of LNG per day](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGSnDAQRL9GZLMlCQQmIFgHZOfAiUNqBCOQT0iUNBy7f-_Cv3BxV3f1e38-pg_0wcf1F-408MulKdJVAjFTnjgdFu074k5l3kLKPtKKJdCkpTYgDWg9LejDe2qqZbBy6VVFg-qarleq7U21DTWa2cje6aa3zhns5s64Bhdna6TG9pUf7jFptFZKqrp-1GiUIWyxVVb-wFY0khbPKT94I6YXFhfe6YvyY057FYaN-Siifgo9Cj1e1_XYS7wzoUeKcBahxz1Fegs93nBCj87nwhDiCmXzB9gzflL2cYXttODvDqxncDAnLAyF5jNTgYPy7rkAJyiMmeFK-VPoETM8n2ps_v7-WeVhOS4fgi9tJxq57ujD_5_8Pbtfg_4XAAD__xjHkXU). LNG is promoted as a [cleaner alternative to traditional ship fuel](http://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGuozAQheGnMZ2RPWADhYtt6O62W6IxDGBpwMh2QvL2q-QVbn2k70j_v5_pBwOHc_uLB7nyWuN00p2ZSqE0lXh59O8TD8rzzjGFkzbMTBMoMFIZCTAtGPg9tdXivFoGXZHTXdsNWtvBVLvrLOhBGSDfG--p0_3QQ9uCJ71qbecquA-mDIDWSjdN3aDRhtCi1V71aEWraAklprrsVOiFeeV3fFKq53hU7PZSriyaPwJGAeN93_W8p3h-VgHj9uBVzhFzETBiKmFmEjB-HcnnJjfMMu_hkuuDWIJqGtuZrr72q0puue7AHLLtRKu2AwN_T8vvUj0d_A8AAP__GMR8yQ), offering significant reductions in sulfur and greenhouse gas emissions. However, the Biden administration suspended LNG exports last year over concerns about environmental pollution from methane gas. President Trump rescinded that order upon assuming office, and his administration issued a response to a federal study that sought to justify the suspension, saying it “defied reason and reality and hurt American progress.”

subject: Help Flip New York Red
body:
The Empire State is on the front line in our fight to Save America

| | | | [](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/awaw/?__vbtrk=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
---
Friend, I’m going to say what the corrupt media Democrats won’t.
**[New York is on the front line in our fight to Save America](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/awaw/?__vbtrk=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)**
It breaks my heart that, under one-party Democrat rule, **New York has become unrecognizable.**
Streets once bustling with families and small businesses are now overrun by _violent criminals_ and ___illegal aliens_ _._ Even _radical pro-terrorist extremists_ are occupying our college campuses, spitting in the faces of Jewish students and chanting for the destruction of America.
You don’t have to take my word for it: Over 630,000 residents left New York between 2020 and 2023, because of failed Democrat policies pricing them out while making their streets less and less safe.
It is a tragedy but it’s exactly what Democrat Governor Kathy Hochul and the Democrat Party want.
The good news is that we can end this madness. In 2022, Lee Zeldin came within just 7 points of becoming the Governor of New York.
**That’s the closest a Republican has come to winning the governorship in decades.**
And all the reasons that New Yorkers almost handed him a victory have only gotten worse:
* Thousands of illegal migrants flooded our cities.
* Crime has skyrocketed.
* New Yorkers are waking up to see illegal immigrant shelters popping up in their neighborhoods overnight.
* Many young people believe they’ll never be able to make it on their own if they don’t move somewhere with a lower cost of living.

New Yorkers don’t want to fear for their children’s safety because woke liberal DA’s let criminals free. They don’t want their children to move across state lines just so they can afford to support young families.
**_[I’m launching the Flip NY Red Fund, because I refuse to let the radical Left destroy the state I love without a fight](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/awaw/?__vbtrk=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**
We need to build our war chest NOW if we’re going to take back the governorship so that we can _**support law enforcement rather than protect illegal migrants**_ , _**make our once proud cities safe again**_ , and work with President Trump to _**deliver an economy that will provide ALL Americans with the opportunity to achieve the American Dream**_.
But my team and I can’t do it alone. We need support and resources from across the country to help us lay the foundation for victory.
**_[That’s why I am humbly asking you to please rush whatever you can spare today to the Flip NY Red Fund to help us break the hold radical Democrats have on New York](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/awaw/?__vbtrk=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)_****.**
****Fellow patriot, if we can save the Empire State, we can save America.
[FLIP NY RED](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/awaw/?__vbtrk=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
I appreciate the support of every patriot who stands with me now in the fight for New York and our nation.
_Your fellow patriot,_
[](https://go.vbtrb.com/r/awaw/?__vbtrk=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNjpuZXdzbGV0dGVy&_uax=MjkxOTcwOjEwMjk5MDQwNg&ct)
**Elise Stefanik**
Proud New Yorker

name: Heidi Ganahl
subject: The Mountain Minute: 5/22/2025
body:
Tina Peters talks evidence, betrayal and faith behind bars
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friends,
TODAY -- an exciting event hosted by our friends at The Peak! 🎙️ Join Bill Federer for a powerful live webinar, “How We Take the Media Back,” on May 22nd. Learn how we got here—and how citizen journalism can reclaim truth in our communities. [Register here »](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
Listen to today's **Mountain Minute Podcast** [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)! Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** In an [EXCLUSIVE RMV interview](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) from the jailhouse, Tina Peters shares new details about evidence she says was ignored, and the betrayal she felt from allies. In Fort Morgan, a new partnership between Cargill and nonprofit BBD is tackling the local housing crisis with [innovative private-sector solutions](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
Meanwhile, Colorado passed a new law banning gun ownership for [repeat car thieves](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), as day two of a high-profile [hate crime “hoax” trial](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) unfolded in Colorado Springs. Denver’s immigration policies are under scrutiny again, with the city now racking up [$250,000 in legal bills](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) to respond to a federal inquiry. And as [tornado season ramps up](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), officials urge residents to sign up for emergency alerts to stay safe.
🇺🇸 **On the National Stage...** Trump’s sweeping “Big, Beautiful Bill” continues to advance in the House, with [Colorado Republicans](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) backing key provisions that would extend tax cuts, tighten work requirements for Medicaid, and roll back Biden-era climate incentives. Meanwhile, the Senate [unanimously passed](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) the “No Tax On Tips Act,” fulfilling a major campaign promise to exempt service workers' tips from federal income tax. And in a major shift, the FDA will [no longer recommend COVID-19 boosters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) for healthy Americans under 65, citing limited benefits and growing public skepticism.
This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, May 22, 2025.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[“They didn’t think I had it”: Tina Peters on evidence, betrayal and faith behind bars](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
In a jailhouse visit marked by resilience, revelation and restrained emotion, former Mesa County Clerk Tina Peters offered a window into the chapter of her life that has largely unfolded behind bars.
For two-and-a-half hours on May 18, we sat across from each other in a controlled visitation room. No pens or paper were allowed, so what follows is drawn from a memory still sharp with immediacy, and a recorded voice memo I made in my truck just moments after we said goodbye.
Peters wore standard prison-issued clothing and a DOC patch with her name and inmate number sewn on. I bought her a cappuccino from the vending machine and a Butterfinger, which I had to unwrap and place on a paper plate before handing it to her across the table. She smiled and said it was a rare treat – something she doesn’t get to experience very often.
What followed was not a defensive rant or a political sermon – but a conversation.

---
**[Cargill and BBD show what private-sector solutions to housing really look like](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Cargill and local contractor Building By Design (BBD) are partnering to build over 200 homes in Fort Morgan, addressing the region’s urgent housing shortage and improving quality of life for workers and families.
* The project emphasizes trust, craftsmanship, and community values, using local labor to reinforce regional identity and avoid bureaucratic slowdowns.
* With strong collaboration from businesses, civic groups, and local leaders, Fort Morgan is showcasing a model of unity and human-centered growth that could inspire similar efforts statewide.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[GET YOUR TICKET HERE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
|
---
**[‘Congressional inquiry’ triggers $250K legal tab for Denver’s sanctuary city stance](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [DENVERITE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Denver has spent $250,000 on legal fees with a top D.C. law firm that prepared Mayor Mike Johnston for the March 2025 congressional hearing on the city’s immigration policies.
* The Republican-led inquiry is probing whether Denver obstructed federal immigration enforcement. Johnston maintains the city complies with federal law but limits cooperation with ICE.
* The city’s contract allows for up to $2 million in legal costs over the year, and officials haven’t ruled out additional invoices. Denver is also involved in lawsuits over immigration grants and policy challenges.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
** ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
**[Out on bond, out of control: Decades of Colorado’s soft-on-crime policies under fire](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY SHAINA COLE****| LOCAL | MAY 20** _A series of violent incidents in Denver during April 2025 has intensified scrutiny of Colorado’s criminal justice reforms, with critics contending that lenient policies on bail and sentencing have compromised public safety._
__
**[Gaines: Phil Weiser spends your tax dollars suing Trump and backing gun control](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY CORY GAINES | COMMENTARY | MAY 20** _I was corresponding with someone recently and they mentioned something interesting. This person is a lawyer and said they were in a 10th circuit (Federal) courtroom recently and overheard an appellate case out of New Mexico about gun control._
__
**[Out of order: Was DNC vice chair David Hogg undone by procedure—or politics?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
**[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)****BY JEN SCHUMANN | NATIONAL | MAY 19** _David Hogg says the Democratic National Committee (DNC) is trying to “fast-track” his removal as vice chair. The party insists it’s just following procedure. But veteran parliamentarian Gregory Carlson says what happened may violate one of the most basic principles of Robert’s Rules of Order – you can’t go back and undo a vote after the meeting is over._
__

Historic guests include George Washington, Alexander Hamilton, and Aaron Burr—who may have argued there before their infamous duel. FDR also launched his political campaigns from its front porch.

**🌾 The Story of YESA Farm 🌾**
---
YESA Farm is located in the heart of Occaneechi Saponi territory, on land that our family has stewarded for more than 200 years in what is now Alamance County, North Carolina. _YESA Farm is where ceremony, seed, soil, and sovereignty come together._ Over 16+ seasons, we've expanded from 4 Directional raised beds to 13, following the Braiding the Sacred model passed to us by our elders. We grow the Three Sisters (Corn, Beans, Squash), the Fourth Sister (Sunflower), traditional fruits, berries, herbs, and medicines. At YESA Farm, we support intergenerational learning, inviting youth to sit beside elders and learn not only how to plant but how to remember. Our programming includes seasonal teachings, community celebrations, food sovereignty training, and healing gatherings. We also host recurring Land Days, where folks of all ages and abilities are invited to come out and tend the land with us. _We have big dreams for this space._ On Sat June 7th, we are hosting our first-ever [**Benefit Event & Silent Auction**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.xqm-apKpWqGuZCDDu9wrxUDfkOJKjLt3RfEVrnWMbNuoANUxM60bMuqgO09cDAX8vctUPzlxbBLPU4skoFw3dd0pIOVhSYMvZm9uCuIGY894Zmxfh1UVlXc7udo_q9tfkdWKOrceJMc9rQNFs3v9h2gwODnBhkRYgE_0dqT8dRtE40ednLJbPenT05dZnde0uqMS1nmqMfSURaizbwbRLZtLhM7PFM8rtA444QMX70i_ShNkYkY6si9ti831qtdvHM0XmAYy5NqtMGTitM-R8VthUumwosbUHWP_m2dLZkw6lnpIk5JmBJqt107rjNOe/4gp/KAuVFK2aQS2-jZYulqBXiw/h5/h001.5nXULlaVcxkb8ecYJ8SZ-zojlh4Wf8EFe6K22R7bIGE) where all proceeds will go towards our YESA Farm vision:
* Expanding the garden
* Building a seed bank
* Restoring a historic community space
* Providing meaningful programming for our community

_Join us for an evening of storytelling, food and fellowship to support YESA Farm!_ YESA Farm Benefit Event & Silent Auction **🕓 Time: **June 7, 2025, from 4:00-7:00 PM **📍 Location:** YESA Farm, Alamance County, NC **🎟️ Tickets include dinner and drinks.**

**[A recent interview between CNN's Elle Reeve and comedian Tim Dillon](https://substack.com/redirect/d96704c1-1740-41b1-9dd3-4c228bfad30e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** revealed the extent to which the corporate media no longer floats the best comedians and is now being dragged along by the current of popular opinion like a rudderless boat.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/d96704c1-1740-41b1-9dd3-4c228bfad30e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Props to Reeve for sitting down with Dillon and doing the interview, seeing any kind of mingling between the pro and anti-Trump flotillas is rare these days, let alone in such long form.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..zysYvLeIbFRGbxkAxbLVkkaXVdzwnYXQzv53TI2nn64?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=164111865)
During the interview, Dillon cited that the divide is not just political, it's between the old institutions and the new media upstarts, "younger people seem to gravitate towards that kind of [new] media more than the kind of fake, stilted, corporate speak of of the traditional legacy media. But I don't know if it's that comedians have gotten smarter, media has gotten dumber."
The New York Times recently wrote a piece headlined, **["Democrats Throw Money at a Problem: Countering G.O.P. Clout Online."](https://substack.com/redirect/ec7cc5f7-0c20-4b6e-a0a1-89b50c2365e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** In short, the left is looking for their Joe Rogan without realizing that Rogan jumped ship because of a politically correct climate that dominates the post-modern left. This ecosystem is antithetical to good comedy because the Liberal atmosphere of openness has been strangled by the rigid and dogmatic ideology of the identitarian, Progressive left.
And herein lies the reason why comedians have turned away from more traditional avenues and are finding their opportunities to speak more freely online. After all, a comic needs to be edgy, and that's not very easy to do if they are forced to follow a carefully tailored script that was approved by the human resources department upstairs.

### **A Message from Donald Trump Jr...**
# **America's "Gold Reset" Could Grow Your 401(k) or IRA If You Do This ASAP**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39d4c87f-af87-48df-9496-d010897587eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Did you know the U.S. government has the legal power to **change the price of gold** with the stroke of a pen?
My father's administration is exploring a powerful economic tool that gives the Treasury the authority to **revalue America's gold reserves** on the national balance sheet from their outdated book value of $42 to current market prices.
This move would immediately...
1. Strengthen America's financial position
2. Signal gold's renewed importance in our monetary system
3. Prepare America for a new era of sound money principles

**This Revaluation Would Create a Perfect Storm for Gold Investors**
When the government officially acknowledges gold's true value, we could see a **surge in gold prices**. The potential upside for gold investors is substantial. And luckily, **there 's a simple way to position yourself to benefit**...
A Gold IRA is a tax-advantaged retirement account that holds physical gold instead of paper assets.
**[Click here to request your FREE Info Kit on Gold IRAs from my trusted friends at Birch Gold Group.](https://substack.com/redirect/39d4c87f-af87-48df-9496-d010897587eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
This comprehensive guide reveals how a Gold IRA works and why it's the perfect vehicle to benefit from the coming gold revaluation. It shows you, step by step, how to legally make this move without paying taxes or penalties.
**[So click here now to get your copy of this free info kit](https://substack.com/redirect/39d4c87f-af87-48df-9496-d010897587eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** - BEFORE this wealth-multiplying policy becomes public knowledge!
[Get My Free Info Kit](https://substack.com/redirect/39d4c87f-af87-48df-9496-d010897587eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
**(Continued)**
If politics is downstream of culture, and new ideas are upstream of cultural change, then as the river of American history flows into the future, comedians are a good indicator of what direction the current is flowing in the current day.
This was no more apparent than during the last election, when one would have been better off looking to the jesters than the pollsters if they wanted to know which way the public would vote.
It's a comedians job to trawl the stream ahead of what is considered acceptable. They cast their jokes deep beneath the surface of polite society, trawling to hook the ideas that everyone thinks in the back of their mind, but are too afraid to say out loud. In order to stay relevant comedians have to explore uncharted waters rather than drag up the same old tired jokes.
Reeve posited the idea that left-leaning comedians are failing, while the ones who lean right are seeing enormous success. Dillon countered by citing numerous successful left-wing comedians, but I must say I agree with Reeve on this point.

Left-leaning comedians are losing contracts and drying out like fish in the sun because inherent to good comedy is a willingness to question and prod the status quo. It just so happens that the right has become the party that is open to change and free speech, while the left continues to dig in their heels. If MAGA supports free speech, then the present left feels compelled to oppose whatever Trumpers support at every turn. Take Biden's immigration policy for example, which had more to do with undoing Trump's secure border agenda than improving the lives of the legal citizens in the United States. Or perhaps an even more pertinent example was Kamala's campaign: **[when asked if she would alter any of Biden's policies, Harris replied, "there is not a thing that comes to mind."](https://substack.com/redirect/5a35272a-c395-48cd-a787-8843b98f824f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** MAGA ran on a platform of change, and the Democrats are stuck in the sand.
So while I agree with Reeve's assertion that left-leaning politicians are failing, I don't think that's a bad thing. There's a reason why comics like Tim Dillon, Joe Rogan, Andrew Schultz, and Shane Gilles are now perceived as leaning right: because apparently supporting free speech or being anti war is now a right wing position and this won't change until the left takes a hard look in the reflection on the surface of the sea. And perhaps that won't happen until it has become painfully obvious that comedians on the far left are not on the cutting edge, but making the same old Orange Man Bad jokes that they have been casting for just shy of a decade. They won't change their tack until these overfished waters are as vapid and empty as their ideology, and they are deprived of the ability to put food on the table.
If the postmodern left wants any hope of buoying bold and daring comics, they will have to steer their operations against the headwinds of politically correct society--away from what they believe to be the safe harbor never-Trumpism--and back towards the pillars of free speech.

| | | Donald Trump is bragging that he's getting a "gift" plane from Qatar, but neglects to mention that it will cost somewhere in the neighborhood of a billion dollars to add the security measures necessary to use it as Air Force One. It's an incredibly stupid move, since we already have multiple plans that can serve as AF1. But what makes it even stupider that is [Trump is taking the plane with him when he leaves office.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T131c5416-d370-4bdd-bfa0-43703e6d3d39/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) **WTF? We're going to spend over a billion on it, and then just give him the plane to take? Why not use it for the next president? Or sell it? Why give it to this pinhead grifter who's already stolen more from the country than all other presidents combined?** Look, if he wants White House M&Ms, or toilet paper, or even that stupid little desk he signs papers at, fine, let him have a souvenir. But there's no way in hell we should give him a plane we spent a billion dollars on. The whole thing is incredibly stupid. Let's not make it even stupider. name: Mark Ronchetti
subject: Media Truth, NM Governor’s Race & the Future of Journalism
body:
No Doubt About It Episode 194 for dpwillis67@gmail.com

| | | | | |
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=67e5a9f844&e=567664f14c)
| | | | | We’re back with a c[an’t-miss episode of the No Doubt About It Podcast](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=570b9c7c40&e=567664f14c)—and this week we’re welcoming a very special guest: Jeff Tucker, Editorial Board Member of the Albuquerque Journal. We dive into the future of media, the New Mexico governor’s race, the border crisis, and what’s next for local journalism as newspapers struggle nationwide.
---
[|
---](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=809092d262&e=567664f14c)
|
# In This Episode:
---
| **📰 The Media's Biden Cover-Up**
We kick things off by discussing the mainstream media’s coordinated silence on President Biden’s health struggles. Jeff Tucker shares his take on why journalistic objectivity is fading, and how editorial boards like the Journal’s are navigating the changing media landscape. Mark and Krysty call out the danger of media silence when it comes to the truth about those in power.
**📊 NM Governor’s Race: Haaland vs. Bregman?**
Jeff makes the case that Sam Bregman has a real shot at winning the Democratic nomination. Mark pushes back hard, arguing that Deb Haaland is likely to dominate in a Democratic primary. This back-and-forth is a must-hear preview of what could be one of New Mexico’s most contentious races in 2026.
---
| [Stream Episode Now](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=ad68b2becc&e=567664f14c)
---
| **🌎 The Border Crisis & “Self-Deportation” Trend **
Jeff recently wrote about the new wave of illegal immigrants choosing to self-deport—and we dig into why it’s happening, what it says about border policy, and where this story is headed.
**🗞️ Are Newspapers Dying?**
What’s Next for Local Journalism? With newspapers shutting down across the country, we ask Jeff point blank: Is the Albuquerque Journal next? We discuss the future of trusted news, how newspapers are adapting, and what must change if local journalism is going to survive.
---

body:
| I promise you that I will continue to fight as hard as I can to protect our environment from Trump and his GOP allies.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=8597%2E5257348%2Erp3M_G)
Derek,
If your community was covered in smog and your kids had to breathe polluted air, wouldn’t you want to do something about it?
I think almost everyone would answer “yes” to this question — unless you’re a Senate Republican. **Last night, Senate Republicans went "nuclear," overruling the Senate Parliamentarian to revoke California's _Clean Air Act_ waivers.**
**[If you agree that we need to keep clean air standards in place to protect our communities from breathing polluted air, add your name to my petition today →](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=abs-eg-cleanair.wmUEpM&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20250522_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=8597%2E5257348%2Erp3M_G)**
[ADD YOUR NAME](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=abs-eg-cleanair.wmUEpM&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20250522_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=8597%2E5257348%2Erp3M_G)
---
Since Donald Trump returned to office, his administration has been downright hostile to any attempts to protect our environment. He’s making it as easy as possible for polluters, fossil fuel companies, and toxic waste dumpers to make our air dirtier and water less clean.
And now, his allies in Congress are following his lead. Senate Republicans overruled the Senate Parliamentarian last night to move forward with a process that would lead to the revocation of California’s clean air standards.
Let’s be clear about what this means, Derek: **Our air will be more polluted. Our kids will be less healthy. And our communities will be covered in smog.**
I’ve been working on this issue since the early days of my career. As an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I fought to hold polluters and toxic waste dumpers accountable for violating environmental laws. My work there even led to the creation of the first federal environmental crimes unit in Los Angeles.
Since then, I’ve continued fighting to protect our environment — first as a member of California’s state legislature, later as a member of the U.S. House, and now in the United States Senate as a member of the Environment and Public Works Committee.
I promise you that I will continue to fight as hard as I can to protect our environment from Trump and his GOP allies. But I need this grassroots team to fight alongside me.
**[Republicans are taking us back to 1955, when our air was dirty and smog covered our communities. But I will do everything I can to protect our clean air for future generations. Sign on today to fight with me and help make sure that we continue to have clean air to breathe.](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1023?c0=abs-eg-cleanair.wmUEpM&refcode=AU_ABS_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20250522_AM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=8597%2E5257348%2Erp3M_G)**

---
Thank you,
Adam

body:
Tune into the latest installment of the Voices of Reason podcast. | | | |
---
| | | Welcome to the latest edition of _Voices of Reason_ where we’ll recap exclusive news and data featured in our most recent podcast.

This special segment dives in with the winner of the Democratic primary for Pittsburgh mayor with an exclusive interview with Allegheny County Controller **Corey O'Connor** , who share views and insights you want to know.
---
| **Big Names Make News**
---
| **Democratic Nominee for Pittsburgh Mayor Corey O’Connor** highlights that while the current bond ratings may be high for Pittsburgh, they do not “plow a street, fix a water fountain, build a playground, or invest in communities,” rather, they force mayors to “cut major initiatives” and ultimately need to “raise fees or add a tax to pay your bond back.” [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=919e9f2a46&e=b7b3eddce2)]

**Corey O’Connor** argues that change is necessary because the current “5-year budget shows fewer people going to be employed in the city of Pittsburgh, as well as real estate taxes declining over those five years and taking on additional debt.” [[Watch](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=cf6b7951ec&e=b7b3eddce2)]
---
|
* * *
---
| **Numbers You Need to Know**
---
| _Elections_
* In the Democratic primary for Pittsburgh mayor, Corey O’Connor won with **52.8%** of the vote, defeating incumbent Ed Gainey, who received only** 47.2%**. [[NYTimes](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=828b3f4808&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* In the Republican primary for Pittsburgh mayor, Tony Moreno won with **69.9%** of the vote, defeating Thomas West, who received only **30.1%**. [[NYTimes](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=92b2bfac1a&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* In the Democratic primary, nearly **19,000 mail-in ballots** were counted, with write-ins making up less than **0.5%** of the vote, while in the Republican race, write-in candidates drew about **12%** of the vote. [[TribLive](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=8f3bc602be&e=b7b3eddce2)]

_Voter Interests_
* Before becoming Allegheny County controller, Mr. O’Connor served **11 years** on Pittsburgh City Council, where he championed legislation on paid sick leave and gun control after the 2018 synagogue shooting. [[PittsburghPost-Gazette](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=44a83b38a7&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* For the second consecutive election, Democrats unseated a sitting mayor in Pittsburgh—an event that hadn’t occurred in nearly **100 years** until Ed Gainey did so **four years** ago by defeating then-Mayor Bill Peduto. [[PittsburghPost-Gazette](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=7a820dde5a&e=b7b3eddce2)]
* This November, voters will fill one vacant seat each on the Commonwealth and Superior Courts and decide whether to grant **five appellate judges** new **10-year terms**. [[SpotlightPA](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=2b48553409&e=b7b3eddce2)]

---
|
* * *
---
| **Corey O'Connor Wins Pittsburgh Mayoral Democratic Primary**
---

---
|
* * *
---
| **In Case You Missed It...**
---
| The _Voices of Reason_ podcast has covered the most important issues in Pennsylvania politics – from [education funding](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=67c2213c86&e=b7b3eddce2) to [trust in elections](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=bce649913d&e=b7b3eddce2). Secretary of the Commonwealth [Al Schmidt](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=4d6ff58da5&e=b7b3eddce2), PA Treasurer [Stacy Garrity](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=3dbd087fc8&e=b7b3eddce2), and House Appropriations Chairman [Jordan Harris](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=feac74f204&e=b7b3eddce2) are just a few of many influential guests who have joined us for exclusive interviews and roundtable discussions.

fix a water fountain, build a playground, or invest in communities,” rather, they force mayors to “cut major initiatives” and ultimately need to “raise fees or add a tax to pay your bond back.” ] Corey O’Connor argues that change is necessary because the current “5-year budget shows fewer people going to be employed in the city of Pittsburgh, as well as real estate taxes declining over those five years and taking on additional debt.” ] | | Numbers You Need to Know | Elections In the Democratic primary for Pittsburgh mayor, Corey O’Connor won with 52.8% of the vote, defeating incumbent Ed Gainey, who received only 47.2%. ] In the Republican primary for Pittsburgh mayor, Tony Moreno won with 69.9% of the vote, defeating Thomas West, who received only 30.1%. ] In the Democratic primary, nearly 19,000 mail-in ballots were counted, with write-ins making up less than 0.5% of the vote, while in the Republican race, write-in candidates drew about 12% of the vote. ] Voter Interests Before becoming Allegheny County controller, Mr. O’Connor served 11 years on Pittsburgh City Council, where he championed legislation on paid sick leave and gun control after the 2018 synagogue shooting. ]
