Did you hear the news? Using the same election-denying messaging that they used to justify the January 6 insurrection, Republicans are once again working to rally their MAGA base to gain a majority on the Pennsylvania Supreme Court this November.

According to _WHYY News_ , in a speech to a group in Erie, a Republican activist stated, “They allowed and engineered the stolen election here in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania,” referring to the three Pennsylvania Supreme Court Justices who were elected as Democrats and are seeking to retain their seats in November. “If you want justice, if you want accountability, if you want to reshape Pennsylvania, you vote no to these people.”

This morning, House Republicans voted to pass President Trump's bill to slash funding for Medicaid
# [](https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/2780?t=1&akid=615%2E2563979%2Ex4QGs6)

Peter ‐
This morning, House Republicans voted to pass President Trump's bill to slash funding for Medicaid, nutrition programs, and other vital programs millions of Americans including those in red states -- need to get by. And they did it to fund tax cuts for some of the wealthiest people in America.
That is not hyperbole; that is fact. And when the vote came in, Republicans chanted USA! USA! USA! on the floor of the House.
Shameful.
If you are outraged at what happened and are looking for a way to make House Republicans pay, the Democratic National Committee is looking for lots and lots of donations today to help flip some of those seats.
If that's all you need to hear, contribute here:
**[**https://act.kamalaharris.com/go/beat-republicans](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc?refcode=em2505022&refcode2=615_2563979_x4QGs6&akid=615%2E2563979%2Ex4QGs6)**

| | _**H.R. 1 - "One Big Beautiful Bill"**_ Today, I proudly voted YES on H.R. 1 "One Big Beautiful BIll" -taking a strong stand to enhance our border security, lower taxes for working families and seniors, and safeguard Medicaid for those who need it most.

**✅ BORDER SECURITY**
Our border is my TOP priority. And this bill adds 10,000 ICE personnel; 5,000 customs officers; 3,000 Border Patrol agents, AND includes bonuses for frontline agents!

PLUS, _the bill finishes hundreds of miles of border wall_.

**✅ CUTS TAXES**
Through this bill, the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA) is extended, ensuring a pro-growth tax code that PREVENTS the largest tax increase in American history.

Without this vital extension, families in our congressional district would face an unnecessary burden of an additional $1,480 in taxes each year.

AND, this bill delivers on two of President Trump's promises:
1\. No tax on tips
2\. No tax on overtime

**✅ MEDICAID**
The Democrats have been lying - and will keep lying - about what this bill does in regards to Medicaid. Because of my work to fight to protect Medicaid, our most vulnerable, single moms, the disabled, the elderly, & the needy will continue to receive care.

In addition, there are needed work requirements and stronger eligibility checks!

This bill roots out waste, fraud, & abuse by implementing stronger eligibility verification & work requirements for able-bodied adults with no dependents.

_**MAKE NO MISTAKE:**_ Democrats will use fear and lies to try and destroy the good work this bill does. Working hand-in-hand with local hospitals, health care providers and stakeholders over the last several months, our district had a seat at the table that influenced and changed the outcome of this bill for the BETTER of our community!

I am **GRATEFUL** to President Trump, Speaker Johnson and all of leadership for delivering on key promises that benefit our district, and I am **PROUD** to be fighting for you every day.

There is more to come! Stay in touch and I hope to see you around the district soon.

Juan

Peter, In less than two weeks, early voting begins in the New Jersey Primary – our first _critical_ opportunity to kick out the lemons and pick Common Sense candidates to represent us on the November ballot. We literally have the chance to write our “menu” of general election candidates. What do you want to order come November? Because the choices will have real consequences.
* Do you want candidates in lock step with President Trump’s efforts to crack down on illegal immigration, secure the border, and deport dangerous criminals _OR_ candidates who talk tough but aren’t willing to stand their ground when the going gets tough or they have to get confrontational with Leftist Lunatics?
* Do you want a working NJ transit system with trains that run and that doesn’t keep reaching in your pocket for more _OR_ more of the same bloated, failing, system that results in rate hikes, delays, strikes, and deadly accidents?
* Do you want to see your property taxes go down _OR_ keep climbing in the name of saving this program or increasing spending here, there, and everywhere?
* Do you want your children actually mastering the academic basics _OR_ spending an increasing amount of time parsing gender variations and listening to drag queens read them sexually explicit books?
* Do you want crime punished _OR_ crime ignored?

YOU have the chance to vet candidates in the June 10th primary – or you can let the establishment do it for you. And we know what they’re vetting for: total and complete allegiance to their power and pocketbooks.

If you have any feedback on how we can make our emails more accessible or relevant, please don’t hesitate to share. While we cannot guarantee every suggestion will be implemented, we will take the time to carefully review and consider your input. Your trust matters, and we work diligently to ensure every email you receive meets these requirements. If you need further clarification on our compliance policies or legal obligations, please feel free to ask. Transparency and accountability are central to our communication strategy, and we’re happy to provide additional details if needed. A Final Note Emails are one of the many ways we stay connected, but we understand they aren’t perfect for everyone. If there’s another way you’d prefer to communicate or stay updated, let us know. Whether it’s through social media, a direct call, or another channel, we’re open to finding the most effective way to share information with you. We want to emphasize that our goal is never to disrupt or clutter your inbox. Every email sent is intended to provide value, and we genuinely appreciate your time and attention. Thank you for allowing us to stay in touch with you. This footer was designed to ensure transparency, provide essential information, and give you full control over your communication preferences. We hope it meets your expectations, but if there’s anything you’d like to see improved, we’re always here to listen.

body:
Let’s connect this landscape

[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108165887/547062773/-1299648888?contactdata=Kn70BqZ63A5VreQm1B2DxagN8T/Bks3Q2EYtFc2UxFM0XuLDByKMqF51gELH2Ds0bdgMSX97AwAVZ5iAg11aHHaKKiuJw4UqGiua+cpJ/IskVUOuyT2QCPFsCtJVRwEeSYCdlCJW1qxoWbahrh4m6WRmy+g93ynL3R+O5UFk/NI=&sourceid=1166308&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFhMWIwYTJhLTIwMzctZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6CezKl-BE7GYs8XFeD0kV6BeYoXPR9AI0LbNGoc_S60=&emci=fe45eb49-4920-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=1a1b0a2a-2037-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
---
Hi Peter,
Maps tell stories and reflect our values as people.
As the Geographic Information Systems (GIS) Manager at Save the Redwoods League, I've always admired the science and art of modern mapmaking. In my work, maps inform important decisions that can improve the health and safety of our redwood forests, and one of the best ways to improve forest resilience is by connecting our landscapes.
[](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108165888/547062774/2018652235?contactdata=Kn70BqZ63A5VreQm1B2DxagN8T/Bks3Q2EYtFc2UxFM0XuLDByKMqF51gELH2Ds0bdgMSX97AwAVZ5iAg11aHHaKKiuJw4UqGiua+cpJ/IskVUOuyT2QCPFsCtJVRwEeSYCdlCJW1qxoWbahrh4m6WRmy+g93ynL3R+O5UFk/NI=&ms=MonteRio3_Image&sourceid=1166308&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFhMWIwYTJhLTIwMzctZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6CezKl-BE7GYs8XFeD0kV6BeYoXPR9AI0LbNGoc_S60=&emci=fe45eb49-4920-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=1a1b0a2a-2037-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
Connected forests are a key factor in supporting a functional ecosystem, enhancing biodiversity, restoring watersheds, and mitigating climate change. The map above fills me with excitement, because **we can make this a reality in Sonoma County.**
Monte Rio Redwoods Expansion is our chance to ensure the habitats, breeding grounds, and food sources of native wildlife are connected. The best part about purchasing and conserving this land is that [**we are so close to acquiring this missing piece.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108165889/547062775/2018652235?contactdata=Kn70BqZ63A5VreQm1B2DxagN8T/Bks3Q2EYtFc2UxFM0XuLDByKMqF51gELH2Ds0bdgMSX97AwAVZ5iAg11aHHaKKiuJw4UqGiua+cpJ/IskVUOuyT2QCPFsCtJVRwEeSYCdlCJW1qxoWbahrh4m6WRmy+g93ynL3R+O5UFk/NI=&ms=MonteRio3_Link1&sourceid=1166308&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFhMWIwYTJhLTIwMzctZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6CezKl-BE7GYs8XFeD0kV6BeYoXPR9AI0LbNGoc_S60=&emci=fe45eb49-4920-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=1a1b0a2a-2037-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)
Mapping land is intriguing because of the story it tells us about the past, present, and future. And because our team has spent time on the ground at Monte Rio Redwoods conducting field observations and gathering essential data, we know that [**conserving this land will mean securing a bright future for our redwood forests.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/108165890/547062776/2018652235?contactdata=Kn70BqZ63A5VreQm1B2DxagN8T/Bks3Q2EYtFc2UxFM0XuLDByKMqF51gELH2Ds0bdgMSX97AwAVZ5iAg11aHHaKKiuJw4UqGiua+cpJ/IskVUOuyT2QCPFsCtJVRwEeSYCdlCJW1qxoWbahrh4m6WRmy+g93ynL3R+O5UFk/NI=&ms=MonteRio3_Link2&sourceid=1166308&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjFhMWIwYTJhLTIwMzctZjAxMS1hNWYxLTYwNDViZGE5ZDk2YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=6CezKl-BE7GYs8XFeD0kV6BeYoXPR9AI0LbNGoc_S60=&emci=fe45eb49-4920-f011-8b3d-0022482a9fb7&emdi=1a1b0a2a-2037-f011-a5f1-6045bda9d96b&ceid=1504551)

## The "Only Democracy in the Middle East" Is Firing At Diplomats
On May 21, 2025, Israeli forces fired "warning shots" at a delegation of 25 diplomats visiting Jenin in the occupied West Bank. The diplomats, representing 31 countries including the UK, Canada, Egypt, and Jordan, were on an official mission organized by the Palestinian Authority to observe humanitarian conditions. Israel claimed the group deviated from an approved route--a common lie they've used in the past to justify killing innocent people. But even if their claim is true, so what? Occupied Palestine is still Palestine. It is not Israel. Israel has no legal authority or right to be there.
Moreover, this act of aggression against international diplomats, especially days after many of those nations threatened sanctions against Israel for war crimes, further underscores the oppressive nature of the Israeli occupation. See the below horrifying video of Israeli soldiers shooting directly at foreign Diplomats on a peace mission in Occupied Palestine. [Video Credit: UK GUARDIAN]
[](https://substack.com/redirect/34d0afca-e907-4d52-87d0-ac4a81f20276?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I have been to Occupied Palestine. I have walked those streets. I have seen the way IDF checkpoints slice through neighborhoods like gashes. I have spoke with fathers who described how their homes were bulldozed, and children too afraid to sleep at night because they might be next. What these diplomats experienced was not a glitch in the system--it is the system.
## Western Nations Threaten Sanctions
This brazen act of aggression comes just 48 hours after the UK, France, and Canada issued a joint statement condemning Israel's war crimes. [They stated](https://substack.com/redirect/41343c11-8b9b-46d0-9ba7-182ef6846489?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg):
> The Israeli Government's denial of essential humanitarian assistance to the civilian population is unacceptable and risks breaching International Humanitarian Law. We condemn the abhorrent language used recently by members of the Israeli Government, threatening that, in their despair at the destruction of Gaza, civilians will start to relocate. Permanent forced displacement is a breach of international humanitarian law.
The leaders warned of "further concrete actions" [including sanctions](https://substack.com/redirect/58c8cb13-1da4-4cf0-bc55-8bf86b00b77a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) if Israel did not cease its military offensive and lift restrictions on humanitarian aid.
And how did Netanyahu respond? He reignited airstrikes on Gaza, broke the already fragile ceasefire, continued the blockade on food and aid, and then opened fire on international diplomats.
Let us be absolutely clear on this: Israel's actions violate international humanitarian law, specifically the Fourth Geneva Convention, which mandates that an occupying power must ensure the provision of food and medical supplies to the population. Israel's violations include:
* **Article 49** - forbidding forcible transfer or deportation of protected persons
* **Article 51** - protecting civilian labor from coercion
* **Article 55** - requiring provision of food and medical supplies
* **Article 56** - requiring medical and public health services
* **Article 59** - mandating relief schemes if occupied populations are inadequately supplied

Israel is at minimum violating every single one of these obligations. The international community must hold Israel accountable for these violations, or this genocide will continue to escalate until the full ethnic cleansing of Gaza is completed.

[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..Gizh1N6DT0gIN1EfrpQ1YkxeDh-Dp376u_aMYazOs2o?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=164151091)
## Starvation Is A War Crime
Meanwhile, despite the stern warnings from the aforementioned nations, Israel reignited bombing campaigns in Gaza, breaking the ceasefire agreement. The UN [reports](https://substack.com/redirect/4aa05469-3e00-41d9-a907-0b07be7a4aa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) a catastrophic humanitarian crisis:
> Aid partners on the ground in Gaza report that the number of hot meals served by those community kitchens that are still operating is declining very quickly. Today, about 260,000 meals have been prepared and delivered across the Gaza Strip. That marks a decrease compared to 840,000 meals last Wednesday - a 70 percent reduction of 580,000 daily meals in just five days.
Furthermore, UN humanitarian chief Tom Fletcher warned that 14,000 babies in Gaza could die within 48 hours if urgent aid is not delivered. He described the limited aid allowed into Gaza as a "_drop in the ocean_ " and emphasized the dire need for immediate humanitarian assistance. Why was their more outrage over the fabricated claim that Hamas beheaded 40 babies, than their is on the real life catastrophe of 14,000 more babies on the cusp of death by starvation (in addition to the hundreds of thousands of Palestinians already killed by Israeli bombing)?
And the United States? Still complicit. Still funding this genocide. Still sending billions of dollars in military aid to Netanyahu's regime. We are at a breaking point. You cannot look at these facts and claim this is "complicated." You cannot fire on diplomats and claim to be a democracy. You cannot starve children and call yourself the victim.
## Conclusion
Finally, as someone who has witnessed the conditions in the occupied Palestinian territories firsthand, I can attest to the suffocating nature of the occupation. The recent targeting of diplomats is not an isolated incident but part of a broader pattern of intimidation and oppression. We must continue to raise our voices, advocate for justice, and demand that our governments cease funding and supporting these actions. So, if you've ever wondered what you would have done during the world's darkest hours, you're doing it now. This is why I incessantly ask you to your voice. Demand your Member of Congress stop funding genocide.

|
Dear Fellow American,

Last month, I sent you this message...and I am sending it to you again today because it is so important!
All of us at Judicial Watch appreciate your interest in our work fighting for the rule of the law and transparency in government.
But I cannot overstate how much our entire team of researchers, investigators and attorneys need the financial support of individual Americans to help us stand up...and stand up successfully...to the powerful forces that want to bring back Washington "business as usual!"
I hope you will read my message again!
[**And I will be very grateful if you will join the Judicial Watch team!**](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74147&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
Tom Fitton

**Date:** Thur, April 24, 2025 at 9:14 AM

| Dear Fellow American,

My colleagues and I deeply appreciate your interest in Judicial Watch and our work, and I strongly encourage you to continue to follow our investigations and lawsuits online! Keeping you informed of our work is very important to us!
You see, a key part of our mission ever since our founding in 1994 has been to spread the word about what our investigations and litigation into public corruption discover, as we break through government secrecy on behalf of the American people's right to know.
That's because we believe, as Benjamin Franklin so eloquently warned, that _"**It is in the region of ignorance that tyranny begins. "**_
But all our work comes with very real costs attached!
...and that is why **[I am making a special request to you today to consider making a _tax-deductible donation_](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74147&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)** to help us continue to serve the cause of honesty and transparency in government as America's most effective open-records laws litigator.
| [Contribute](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74147&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2)
---

I am asking for your support today because these are unprecedented times, as the Left **desperately tries to reassert its destructive agenda for America.**

Judicial Watch needs your help so we can score _more_ victories in our legal fights to:

* _Keep our elections honest._
* _Keep uncovering government documents_ that expose Deep State efforts to sabotage President Trump's actions to end illegal immigration and reform the government.
* _Keep challenging the woke agenda_ ...like race-based "reparations" schemes.

Judicial Watch is leading on all these fronts...but _we cannot carry forward our work, including a caseload of nearly 200 lawsuits, without[the_ _help_ of patriotic Americans like you](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=74147&L=30946&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvZG9uYXRlL3RoYW5rLXlvdS0yMTYvP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9ZGVwbG95ZXImdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BTWpjd09EazVOVFElM0QmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPU1heSZ1dG1fdGVybT1Ob24tRG9ub3Jz&hash=aafc90fdace25a5a1871d30fa9a66413e29290f69056683c8a490d5fbaf2a4d2).

I thank you again for your interest in our work, and I hope you will decide today to support our work with a contribution!

Thomas Fitton

clean_body: | | | Lauren Boebert and House Republicans just voted for Donald Trump’s so-called “One Big Beautiful Bill” — a massive, 1,100-page proposal that slashes Medicaid by $880 billion to fund tax breaks for billionaires and corporations. If passed by the Senate, this bill could strip health coverage from over 13 million Americans, including thousands right here in Colorado’s 4th District. The very fact that Boebert voted for this bill shows that she stands with wealthy donors, not working families. John’s not in this race to play politics —he’s in it to protect working families. He believes healthcare is a right, not a bargaining chip for billionaire tax cuts. Lauren Boebert wants to gut Medicaid—ripping away care from children, seniors, and struggling families —just to hand more money to the ultra-rich. That’s not just wrong. It’s a direct assault on our community’s health and dignity. Families like his have depended on Medicaid when a loved one gets sick—and right now, we’re losing sleep over the threats people like Boebert are making. John knows what’s at stake. And we know we can’t afford to let her win. John won’t stand by while politicians treat our lives as disposable. He’s fighting to protect and expand healthcare—not dismantle it—and he needs your help to do it. | | | | Thanks to the support by conservatives from across the state, last week's third annual Legislative Awards Ceremony was a huge success. A sincere thank you to all those who attended and contributed their time and treasure to help Greater Georgia fulfill its mission of engaging, registering and activating voters.
If you couldn't make it, there are still many opportunities ahead to stay engaged. Stay tuned for more stops on our Statewide Education Tour \- coming to [Savannah on June 2](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016BeP3-zK1Qm0mAo_JZ7Ag3ZG26UstFJjc11y1nGB55tws_DE1O0RkPX36mdemR56KalRREGM9eh2paOYcTle1zh8SBTwRSQySK7BcIz0XGCcvO_hNSL9H4LR9WbX-JylCOWic6srGoUQg2Kl2mt6BxrSuijwL-wvxvUEuB5E8uFkr2TmFZOJGIWORvtLE4Y9Gw4Txb20e8iqBZNXT3AI_10Mu-uIt6pgpyak1MooDgpfoRA2Vt1KwdmrLd97WdJCTub2KGie_XSQH1NdmaXksw==&c=rE7TZyAXc0WjKb9AOQCdeNq6CwLhx_BOUoUPZy_KDM02F38MllVGMA==&ch=FNU1oIt5mvVXhobca2zVsXGRJlXtlW44hVVjGRMRcnDYJRxntpUkJQ==) and [Macon on June 11](https://fsdy8nbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016BeP3-zK1Qm0mAo_JZ7Ag3ZG26UstFJjc11y1nGB55tws_DE1O0RkPX36mdemR56a9EvhsB6krT4Dw3ZzMVEeHHXCNRIHriUvT8WPeUtTLvsqWDrINP0YGV4sdFsnN5zHLpvuzV5BVl0iS7uWCwx2Md8lIjKnZC0feHEEL-F2b4tzIOkRkYJpGRuSERZAjPbptV7CYCOV1rcV6apVQKNsPoa2sKqSOlyAunE8E_xaWSus9xUbf-F4gGI7EQyk9nW8baItBaYq7ipehd6vDarxTfRoTZSQStNjZaJx32laTw=&c=rE7TZyAXc0WjKb9AOQCdeNq6CwLhx_BOUoUPZy_KDM02F38MllVGMA==&ch=FNU1oIt5mvVXhobca2zVsXGRJlXtlW44hVVjGRMRcnDYJRxntpUkJQ==) \- as we hit the road to highlight conservative victories passed this legislative session.

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE THURSDAY, MAY 15 Greater Georgia Awards Legislators, Reaffirms Mission for 2025 - 2026
ATLANTA, GA -- This evening, Greater Georgia hosted its third annual Legislative Awards Ceremony. The Honorable Kelly Loeffler, Governor Brian Kemp, and Lieutenant Governor Burt Jones joined Georgians from across the state to honor the exceptional work by eight legislators in the Georgia General Assembly.
Greater Georgia congratulates award recipients Senator Matt Brass, Senator Ben Watson, Senator Randy Robertson, Senator Drew Echols, Representative Jan Jones, Representative Will Wade, Representative Martin Momtahan, and Representative Lehman Franklin, and thanks these outstanding legislators for delivering common sense conservative policy victories for taxpayers and families.
Greater Georgia is focused on supporting conservative policies -- and recognizing those who make them possible -- so we can continue writing Georgia's success story. Through year round community engagement, open and local policy discussion, voter registration and mobilization, and protecting election integrity, Greater Georgia will continue to promote the conservative cause in 2026 and beyond.

Greater Georgia, founded by former U.S. Senator Kelly Loeffler in 2021, is working to register, engage, educate, and mobilize voters in communities across the Peach State. Our year-round work is focused on growing our movement by registering voters who may not be captured by Georgia's "Motor Voter" program, mobilizing diverse and unrepresented communities, promoting issue advocacy, and fighting to restore trust and integrity in our elections.

| Hi Friend —
---
After my last message about voter singularity and “Smart Paper,” we received a wide range of responses — some hopeful, some cautious, and some deeply concerned.
I want you to know: I understand. And you’re right to ask questions.
Technological advancements are reshaping every part of our lives—how we bank, shop, even how we communicate. Elections should be no exception. Now is the time to demand meaningful reform through tech innovation, while we still have the chance to shape a system that reflects the values of transparency, integrity, and citizen control.
We’ve all seen the damage caused by _misuse_ of election technology— when unseen systems make decisions that affect our lives, when accountability disappears behind complexity, when those in power turn complexity into confusion, then wield it as a weapon.
That’s exactly why we’re having this conversation. Because technology is moving fast — and what comes next must be built with honesty, simplicity, and the consent of the voters. Not with machines controlled by rogue agents. Not behind closed doors. Not with fine print. Not with blind faith. That time has passed. Citizens must engage in what comes next — or it will come next without us.
The only way to ensure these systems serve _us_ is to be part of shaping them from the start.
### On faith.
I also know many people of faith are watching the rapid advances with growing concern. It can feel overwhelming — even threatening — as if humanity is losing its soul in a world moving too fast. But we must also remember: God is not surprised by any of this. He is not absent from our future. His sovereignty does not end where innovation begins.
| | _“But_ _the plans of the LORD stand firm forever, the purposes of His heart through all generations.”_
---

Psalm 33:11
So, if you felt unsure or even alarmed by terms like _blockchain_ or _Smart Paper_ , let’s talk about what these ideas _actually_ mean, and what they don’t.
### Why Blockchain?
Let’s start by talking about blockchain. Many people were concerned by my suggestion that election processes could be reliably supported by blockchain — and it seemed like there was some confusion about blockchain being the same thing as Bitcoin. Blockchain is not Bitcoin. Blockchain is just a system of recordkeeping that _can’t be changed or hidden_. Bitcoin and other crypto currencies use blockchain technology to keep accurate records. Blockchain is also used for things like supply chain management, medical records, real estate transactions, and more. It’s a distributed ledger — a secure open notebook — that anyone can read, but no one can erase.
Imagine if voter registrations, ballot counts, and election certifications were written into a system that _no one_ could manipulate — not a political party, not a government agency, not a vendor. That’s the vision. Not surrender. Not secrecy. Transparency by design.
### Why Smart Paper?

Think of it like a tamper-evident seal on a medicine bottle. You don’t need to open the bottle to know if it’s been messed with — the seal tells you if it’s safe and authentic.
In the digital world, that “seal” can be a string of numbers and letters created by a secure formula (called a _hash_). For example, when a ballot is printed, the system could generate a unique hash (aka digital fingerprint) that’s tied to that exact ballot.

It’s a way to add security and transparency to your ballot _without_ giving up the privacy of your vote.

Dear Fellow American,

I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter.

It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future.

A movement is growing, led by progressives—but supported by many well-meaning Americans—to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution.

That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a National Survey on Presidential Selection.

By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue—views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders.

You can complete the National Survey on Presidential Selection by using the link below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jdh8t9b4kokeyiys87ll1cj8eamx34rzdrd7lb7v3fjygoxjkzqb2s7d4at0m79k98rj93pzb95v82jingfdeeggo7s83ifvi14kg38undn16359v4s3kwd2qpy29xz9fbblpe8i8t99kkqg5if0&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swo7em&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swo7em&__onlt=t

Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?

YES
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swo7em&__onlt=t

NO
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swo7em&__onlt=t

For most of our nation's history, the Electoral College, as devised by the Framers of our Constitution, was not controversial. Indeed, it was considered essential to preserving free and representative government.

But today, more than a dozen states have joined together in an attempt to undermine this constitutional bulwark of liberty.

This movement to undermine the Constitution has grown largely because of the failure of America's schools to provide young people with a proper grounding in American civics—too many Americans simply don't understand the importance of the Constitution, including the Electoral College, to liberty.

Because of this, Hillsdale College has expanded its educational mission on behalf of liberty nationwide, directly teaching millions of Americans in all 50 states.

These efforts, which aim to counter the Left's domination over most of our schools, include:

Teaching millions of citizens nationwide through free online courses, such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope;"

Reaching over six million households and businesses nationwide with Imprimis, Hillsdale's free digest of liberty;

Promoting constitutional education through social media outlets popular with young people;

Sending millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to citizens and K-12 schools across America; and

Restoring excellence to K-12 education by helping establish and guiding classical K-12 schools nationwide and providing, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum (including American civics) to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.

Your answers to the National Survey on Presidential Selection will help Hillsdale form the most effective strategy to educate millions of Americans about the importance of the Constitution to liberty—including the importance of the Electoral College.

And this is especially important in this critical time for America's future.

So please share your views on this urgent topic by completing our National Survey on Presidential Selection and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time.

You can take the survey using this secure link I've provided below:

http://trk.victorymailings.com/?xtl=17x64w94u6jdh8t9b4kokeyiys87ll1ds5xk387kk8364ybr7smyqgiic09jtls2uaf70drbtjuktipkoesrawazwgdel1g0m10f8hatjj3yag7jwubxfgkqaxfhkvjq40d92boivsm0utne6ju9kak4kg0pbx&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swo7em&__onlt=t
http://trk.victorymailings.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=swo7em&__onlt=t

And after you take your survey, I hope you will also consider supporting Hillsdale College with a tax-deductible gift.

Since 1844, Hillsdale has been "pursuing truth and defending liberty." Today, it does so through its extensive educational outreach efforts while refusing to accept ONE PENNY of government funding—not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

The support of private citizens like you is essential to our work.

Please represent your state and take the National Survey on Presidential Selection today. Thank you for your time and attention—and for your friendship and support of liberty.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn

President, Hillsdale College

Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

| | Friend,
I love America — not just because I was born here, but because I know what it’s like to live without freedom.
You see, I was only 8 years old when I was taken from my home in Ohio and left behind in Iraq to live under Saddam Hussein’s brutal regime.
**[Overnight, I lost the freedoms so many of us take for granted and was forced to live in a country where women had no rights, speaking out could cost you your life, and your future was not your own.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b302652965c845648430dec0d32314bd&_e=MUZ0Ie-gZ2BY5ukwj_Qt9hlsc0JTIDnoJuXq7Nnq5eJqfLh2nsZDSOlpYpx52am-njuluM7oGEyp1Rgqb7GfDKWMgpPgVGkhx3sIdo0zlttDjKcNkCpcdiyasvjEstVw-Cab-ac_H5gWbZB2Da-hBYUjgkdBFY6xpzn-573_SntU5i-dHSwh1seyWQQeLUkKmxSr6TJfUBULQpb5kUwAliJMmq0I-vjlc4jyDCY-Q4WJ2BHfl-7HmZ-qx8m13PnYSEEU2ULXiYGqHJuHTBkLSCRut05v8TQFTYn9YvT1P_qB3R4Bzgd3s6HwFmQ172X2GpFK5epZNY05PDE_Agw-baa7x3BWZmcyDRENyv7IlCjLMRVUbUz9ZLwhG9HU3eQw)**

If I had never made it back to America, my life would have been unrecognizable.

**[That’s why I’m fighting to protect the freedoms that changed my life and to defend the country that gave me a second chance. Please chip in today to help me in this fight.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=b302652965c845648430dec0d32314bd&_e=MUZ0Ie-gZ2BY5ukwj_Qt9hlsc0JTIDnoJuXq7Nnq5eJqfLh2nsZDSOlpYpx52am-njuluM7oGEyp1Rgqb7GfDKWMgpPgVGkhx3sIdo0zlttDjKcNkCpcdiyasvjEstVw-Cab-ac_H5gWbZB2Da-hBYUjgkdBFY6xpzn-573_SntU5i-dHSwh1seyWQQeLUkKmxSr6TJfUBULQpb5kUwAliJMmq0I-vjlc4jyDCY-Q4V6Et5BSiuHX7WTEPLCjLNeQzcfDhGNkU2krNtgKxpY7WhaBojUlPvtGsHIkiQXsdpMnCcWxHoXKhpMAJikcpLD_PttmUnzJn1PimWOy3taJuRlkxj0OPGA4V_xvWlxfcoJEdlCFaT2RDJNQ1CzufV6)******__****

clean_body: I grew up under Saddam Hussein’s brutal regime. Here’s why I fight for freedom: | | | | | | | | Friend, I love America — not just because I was born here, but because I know what it’s like to live without freedom. You see, I was only 8 years old when I was taken from my home in Ohio and left behind in Iraq to live under Saddam Hussein’s brutal regime. | | If I had never made it back to America, my life would have been unrecognizable. I wouldn’t have had the chance to enlist in 2003, serve my country in the Air Force, rise through the ranks to Lieutenant Colonel, or have the opportunity to run for Congress today. ** | | | | When I finally made it back to America at 12 years old, I promised myself I would give back to the country that never stopped fighting for me. That’s why I joined the Air Force. That’s why I dedicated my life to defending our nation and protecting our way of life.__ | | | | Our enemies are growing bolder. Our freedoms are being eroded. Weak leaders in Washington have forgotten what it means to serve. But, I haven’t. I know what’s at stake, because I’ve seen what happens when freedom disappears. That’s why I will never stop fighting for this country. But I can’t do it alone. | | | | | | | | | | America is the greatest country in the world, and I will do everything in my power in Congress to keep it that way. subject: One, Big, Beautiful Bill: Thank your Republican congressman for voting yes
body:
President Trump’s “One, Big, Beautiful Bill” has passed the House and now heads to the Senate.
| | | |
---
|
---
| Patriot-

---
| **** President Trump's "One, Big, Beautiful Bill" has passed the House and now heads to the Senate. Republican lawmakers worked together to get this important piece of legislation through Congress and we want to thank them for getting it done.
The Left has worked overtime to create the narrative that this bill will rip away rights, leave Americans in turmoil, cause children and the elderly to starve and lose medical care, etc., etc. But as with everything the Left claims, these assertions are all lies.
And while it is not a perfect bill, the fact is, there are some really great policies included. For instance:
> ✅ Tax Cuts are made Permanent✅ No Tax on Tips✅ No Tax on Overtime✅ REINS Act Included✅ Border Security and Deportations✅ Medicaid work requirements✅ No funding for trans mutilation of minors

So, yes, we know there are pieces of this bill that need some work--look for action items next week, especially regarding the new entitlement/giveaway, "Trump Savings Accounts"--but Speaker Mike Johnson and others did move the ball forward on many of the issues that are important to our movement. That is a good thing.
The Left's lies could have easily derailed this bill completely and permanently, and their activists are already calling Republicans to shame them and scare them into opposing any future versions of the bill that come back from the Senate. They want President Trump to fail, and as we've always discussed, politicians need carrots and sticks. Now is the time for the carrots.
**ACTION****:** **Call the United States Capitol Switchboard at (202) 224-3121 and ask for your representative by name. Tell them**** thank you for voting for the One, Big, Beautiful Bill.** It is critical that we not only tell our legislators what we want them to vote for, but also thank them when they do it. Don't know who your representative is? That's okay, [**go to this website**](https://qcgp-cmpzourl.maillist-manage.com/click/1edb9794ab397ef3/1edb9794ab38f38a) and input your zip code, then call the switchboard and ask for your representative by name.
As the bill comes to the Senate, we will have our work cut out for us, but this is a great start!
In liberty,
Jenny Beth Martin **__****__****__****__** __ **__** **** ************

As you probably saw, Republicans jammed through their “big beautiful bill” in the early morning hours today (we ended voting at 6am). This devastating bill strips health care from 14 million people all so Trump can fund his tax cuts for billionaires like Elon Musk. It’s a heartless bill and I voted no. The bill passed by a vote of 215-214, we lost it by one vote. This is a nightmare for the community I love. Hospitals will close and premiums will skyrocket. Families won’t be able to take their kids to the doctor, prescriptions will go unfilled and ER wait times will spike. Thousands of local health care workers will be laid off. I know I may sound dramatic, and yes I’m going off of zero sleep, but I truly am disgusted that this is where Trump and Republicans have taken our country. Their values are right out in the open for everyone to see, and they aren’t ashamed. The Senate still hasn't passed the bill, so until Trump signs it, I’ll be doing everything I can to stop this from becoming law. I’m headed home to California for a long week of conversations with our health care leaders to figure out what we’re going to do next. Don’t let anyone tell you elections don’t matter. Stay in the fight,
Josh
---

Since returning to office barely three months ago, President Trump has waged a seemingly unrelenting "[blitzkrieg](https://substack.com/redirect/465cf140-69a0-486c-a75c-77db1ffcb29b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" on America. My greatest concerns center on his administration's erosion of rights, freedoms, and the rule of law--but its attacks on the economy seem to have drawn greater concern.
The first post in this series explored how Trump administration policies on trade, immigration, and labor have all [started to wreak havoc](https://substack.com/redirect/c5dc42d9-ec2b-48da-9758-ece9f1e0db7a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the U.S. economy. That post focused on costs associated with international [tariffs](https://substack.com/redirect/8c97ae66-ea07-4438-af3d-d332a2bc7667?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), collapsing foreign [tourism](https://substack.com/redirect/22510415-2aea-4739-b0e3-2d4a7f2ce6e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), increasing domestic [labor shortages](https://substack.com/redirect/48db91e8-3632-4914-b212-5c87e87beb50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) challenging vulnerable industries including construction and agriculture, and a generational tide of [displaced government workers](https://substack.com/redirect/e87b21ea-7b63-4fa1-adfe-b824b6cc5af3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Since publishing that initial post in this series, I've noticed several [reports confirming my concerns](https://substack.com/redirect/b3c3981e-b25b-4ecb-95a0-c78de7c56fbc?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) about the cascading effects of economic contraction, [particularly in rural states](https://substack.com/redirect/130eeec5-f8fd-44e6-8b31-9df997f224eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The post continues the analysis by observing four more ways in which federal policies are undermining economic stability. This series will continue with at least one more post.

### **An economic sword of Damocles**
The [sword of Damocles](https://substack.com/redirect/789b189b-3455-4451-b36f-dfb5d0063d9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) references a myth about a man allowed to rule as king, on the condition that a sword hang above his throne suspended by a single hair of a horse's tail. While enthralled by the power and prestige of his position, the circumstance also forced him to grapple with its precarity.
While the American economy is the world's strongest, it remains subject to outside forces. That has been the eventual implication of the corporate globalization that, in a previous era, hollowed out domestic manufacturing industries.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/36729c7c-1376-42d4-8247-9ca4e090b6ad?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
I have long wondered, for instance, when China might take advantage of the chance to impose pressure on Washington by selling part of its substantial U.S. treasury holdings. That reportedly [started last month and forced Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/1d731305-3f9c-4a01-9aae-2655c1c185a7?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to delay the onset of some signature tariffs that he had previously boasted about.
This post explores another handful of ways that Trump administration policies are damaging America's economy, in ways that (my next post will explore) might ironically help humanity writ large.
### **5\. Undermining consumer confidence, threatening housing markets and real estate values**
The combined impact of Trump's economic policies--including [tariffs](https://substack.com/redirect/8c97ae66-ea07-4438-af3d-d332a2bc7667?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [tourism](https://substack.com/redirect/22510415-2aea-4739-b0e3-2d4a7f2ce6e6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), domestic [labor shortages](https://substack.com/redirect/48db91e8-3632-4914-b212-5c87e87beb50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and [displaced government workers](https://substack.com/redirect/e87b21ea-7b63-4fa1-adfe-b824b6cc5af3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--has imposed massive costs on American economic growth and [decimated consumer confidence](https://substack.com/redirect/436a5d8b-659e-42f6-ad3d-9c30fda2bf41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
According to CBS News, [44% of Americans approved](https://substack.com/redirect/8eb0abee-5e6c-4a36-bef6-ba695613a2aa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of Mr. Trump's handling of the economy in April, a drop of 7% from the 51% approval rating previously reported on March 2. Just yesterday, the University of Michigan updated its [consumer sentiment index](https://substack.com/redirect/436a5d8b-659e-42f6-ad3d-9c30fda2bf41?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which declined 2.7% from the month before to 50.8, the lowest level reported since July 2022. Consumer sentiment has tumbled nearly 30% since the beginning of 2025.

One of the biggest ways that consumer confidence impacts the economy is by either inhibiting or instead encouraging people to make substantial investments, for instance, in homes. Noting the impact of President Trump's policies on consumer confidence, J.P. Morgan recently advised its clients that housing "demand--often understood through existing home sales--[remains exceptionally low](https://substack.com/redirect/9111b488-967e-46c9-9959-e7ba5bf948e0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)," and that "housing inventory...remains below historical averages."
Were housing markets more exposed to shocks in the broader economy, I'd anticipate that real estate prices around the country should suffer dramatically. But, for better or worse, I have yet to see evidence of that effect beyond [the nation's capital](https://substack.com/redirect/7b058040-c646-4b53-9b06-da7fab1b579b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
The bizarre [continuity and stability in housing prices](https://substack.com/redirect/569245b2-3f5f-43db-94d0-3fbe73de75be?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) across the country might reflect structural barriers to financial accountability in the housing market. For instance, banks play a crucial role in keeping the racket running, but that's the subject for another post.
### **6\. Degrading economic infrastructure: the USPS**
The right wing's attacks on the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) date back to Trump's first term, when he [appointed](https://substack.com/redirect/1f10a3fb-b87d-486a-ab44-b2a1029771dd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) Postmaster Louis DeJoy to [run the agency into the ground](https://substack.com/redirect/bcacd6d0-5c5b-4dcc-a1f8-477f64fd0210?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Long a source of [upward class mobility for Black Americans](https://substack.com/redirect/2f1139d3-af29-45f7-851a-5f6396386372?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the USPS historically played as crucial a role in racial integration as the [military service branches](https://substack.com/redirect/802c643c-0b75-48d5-8e08-4c8398f39bc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The Postal Service has also served as a [bedrock](https://substack.com/redirect/16fab849-f1f6-43d6-94c2-7ef9e207f232?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the American economy, delivering goods, and allowing businesses to reach their customers at relatively low cost.
The administration has announced that [at least 10,000 postal workers will lose their jobs](https://substack.com/redirect/d8f8595a-aaa3-4fb8-9553-b07ea2e63e5e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), while indicating that more will soon join them. To whatever extent the USPS struggled to satisfy consumer expectations before, it will grow only more challenged as its workforce shrinks.
I've had a chance to experience the erosion of the USPS first hand.
Since 2022, I've worked primarily as a snowboard instructor during the winter. That role frequently puts me in a position to accept cash tips. Since my bank doesn't have a location near where I live, and didn't allow cash deposits via ATM, I've made a practice of visiting the local post office to obtain money orders which I then deposit in my bank account via snail mail.
Earlier this year, I sent a money order to my bank for deposit in my account. I paid extra at the Post Office counter for certified mail, since I knew I might need to track the deposit.
In the past, such deposits were normally received my bank and credited to my account within days. This time, however, it took several times longer than that. When I noticed that it did not seem to have been received after a week, I checked the USPS website to track the package, learning only that delivery was still in process. I did so again on half a dozen other occasions, and ultimately waited three weeks for that check to be delivered.
That's just a single anecdotal example, but it indicates the challenges facing even the delivery of certified mail.
One might imagine that private services could conceivably replace the Postal Service, but none wield the scale necessary to perform all of its functions. If anything, shocks to the broader economy are cascading by limiting the ability of private corporations to deliver mail. For instance, the United Parcel Service (UPS) has [announced](https://substack.com/redirect/3b8cea12-49a9-4957-906f-00816a804e75?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) plans to cut tens of thousands of jobs this year, citing not only abstract "changes in the global trade policy," but also specifically "new or increased tariffs".

### **7\. Degrading economic infrastructure: the FAA**
The Federal Aviation Administration performs several functions, including regulating air traffic control and setting minimum safety standards.
Accidents involving airplanes have grown alarmingly frequent, driven to a large extent by staffing crises and government cuts made in the banner of suppressed efficiency that have instead sent travelers to early graves.
Even after a fatal midair collision at Reagan National Airport that killed 67 people in January, the Trump administration [fired hundreds of FAA staff](https://substack.com/redirect/e02d00a5-34ce-44b6-991d-7bcb88daf7e1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), including personnel hired for maintaining radar, landing and navigational aids.
The airport in Newark, NJ serving the New York metropolitan area has offered a [particular reflection](https://substack.com/redirect/1ad7d0fe-026a-467b-b750-81ceb6becf08?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of the predictable impacts. Jonathan Stewart, a veteran air traffic controller, was [quoted by CNN](https://substack.com/redirect/d4e6922c-d514-4ed8-99da-d85be8965910?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) just last week to voice alarms with staffing and technology gaps. According to CNN, Stewart's concerns included "working multiple positions per shift to give other air traffic controllers breaks and having to write callsigns in a notebook out of fear of losing radar and radios." In his words, "Pushing people beyond their limits is not good business....I don't want to be responsible for killing 400 people."
Technology issues have also impacted other airports, including [Denver's](https://substack.com/redirect/73597ae6-6db6-4329-b171-ba7ac60870cf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), where air traffic controllers lost communications with airplanes in flight for over a minute last Monday, May 12. The Denver Air Route Traffic Control Center covers a massive expanse of airspace, encompassing 285,000 square miles across nearly ten states.
2025 has already emerged as the most deadly year in U.S. aviation in decades. Degrading public infrastructure that used to safeguard airplane safety effectively invites more blackouts, collisions, and even deaths. Beyond the direct impacts of those preventable events, a resulting chilling effect inhibiting other potential travelers has already carried further economic impacts that, to my knowledge, no one has yet quantified.

### **8\. Undermining Social Security could put legions of seniors on the streets**
Enacted during the Great Depression to provide an economic lifetime lifeline to struggling workers as they face replacement by younger workers, Social Security has played a vital function in allowing the poorest Americans to enjoy stability in their older years. The system has been operational for nearly 90 years and currently administers annual benefits totaling roughly $1.6 trillion in benefits to around 70 million Americans.
All of them would struggle to survive should the solvency of the Social Security system become compromised.
The solvency of the system over the long-term has been [called into question for decades](https://substack.com/redirect/b81c5aa0-1b67-4ecc-a706-0d053b8a8b9a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), but never has it faced threats as dire as those that confront it today. A Gallup poll released this spring found that [52% of U.S. adults](https://substack.com/redirect/84b3c203-0484-4a96-aa89-a2300149fb15?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are expressing "a great deal" of worry about the program's future, a 15-year high.
Those concerns appear to be well-founded. According to workers at the Social Security Administration (SSA), staffing cuts and office closures have prompted "[complete, utter chaos](https://substack.com/redirect/1c59e775-541b-4a72-993a-f5d9bb1a3cd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)" and threaten to send the agency into a "death spiral."
The agency's website has crashed several times this year, while public-facing phone services have been cut. Meanwhile, the Acting Commissioner has confirmed that DOGE staff are effectively running the SSA.
One long-time agency worker and military veteran specifically criticized cuts recommended by the so-called Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) once led by right wing industrialist Elon Musk, explaining that "[No one knows what's going on](https://substack.com/redirect/1c59e775-541b-4a72-993a-f5d9bb1a3cd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They're just coming up with ideas at the top of their head....Common sense is something they lack. They don't know what they're doing."
According to a spokesperson for the American Federation of Government Employees' Social Security Administration general committee, the union representing over 40,000 social security workers, the current administration's cuts at the SSA represent "[a concerted attack](https://substack.com/redirect/1c59e775-541b-4a72-993a-f5d9bb1a3cd1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the legitimacy of social security itself. The promise that this country has made to the public with respect to income security is being broken."
Previous administrators of the system have warned that its solvency is in rapid decline, and warned the public in a recent Senate hearing about [impending cuts in benefits](https://substack.com/redirect/b828ee46-ba48-4aaa-8bdb-662d42569bb6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) that could be made inevitable by staffing cuts and the closure of offices.
Any suspension of benefits--however brief--could put millions of seniors on the streets.

That post focused on costs associated with international , collapsing foreign , increasing domestic challenging vulnerable industries including construction and agriculture, and a generational tide of . Since publishing that initial post in this series, I've noticed several about the cascading effects of economic contraction, . The post continues the analysis by observing four more ways in which federal policies are undermining economic stability. This series will continue with at least one more post. Thanks for reading Chronicles of a Dying Empire! You can help inform your friends by sharing this post. An economic sword of Damocles The references a myth about a man allowed to rule as king, on the condition that a sword hang above his throne suspended by a single hair of a horse's tail. While enthralled by the power and prestige of his position, the circumstance also forced him to grapple with its precarity. While the American economy is the world's strongest, it remains subject to outside forces. That has been the eventual implication of the corporate globalization that, in a previous era, hollowed out domestic manufacturing industries. | | ---|---|--- I have long wondered, for instance, when China might take advantage of the chance to impose pressure on Washington by selling part of its substantial U.S. treasury holdings. That reportedly to delay the onset of some signature tariffs that he had previously boasted about. This post explores another handful of ways that Trump administration policies are damaging America's economy, in ways that (my next post will explore) might ironically help humanity writ large. 5\. Undermining consumer confidence, threatening housing markets and real estate values The combined impact of Trump's economic policies--including , , domestic , and imposed massive costs on American economic growth and . According to CBS News, of Mr. Trump's handling of the economy in April, a drop of 7% from the 51% approval rating previously reported on March 2. Just yesterday, the University of Michigan updated its , which declined 2.7% from the month before to 50.8, the lowest level reported since July 2022. Consumer sentiment has tumbled nearly 30% since the beginning of 2025. Chronicles of a Dying Empire is a publication supported by readers rather than advertisers. To receive new posts,sign up for a free subscription! To support my work, please consider becoming a paid subscriber. One of the biggest ways that consumer confidence impacts the economy is by either inhibiting or instead encouraging people to make substantial investments, for instance, in homes. Noting the impact of President Trump's policies on consumer confidence, J.P. Morgan recently advised its clients that housing "demand--often understood through existing home sales--," and that "housing inventory...remains below historical averages." Were housing markets more exposed to shocks in the broader economy, I'd anticipate that real estate prices around the country should suffer dramatically. But, for better or worse, I have yet to see evidence of that effect beyond . The bizarre across the country might reflect structural barriers to financial accountability in the housing market. For instance, banks play a crucial role in keeping the racket running, but that's the subject for another post. 6\. Degrading economic infrastructure: the USPS The right wing's attacks on the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) date back to Trump's first term, when he Postmaster Louis DeJoy to . Long a source of , the USPS historically played as crucial a role in racial integration as the . The Postal Service has also served as a of the American economy, delivering goods, and allowing businesses to reach their customers at relatively low cost. The administration has announced that , while indicating that more will soon join them. To whatever extent the USPS struggled to satisfy consumer expectations before, it will grow only more challenged as its workforce shrinks. I've had a chance to experience the erosion of the USPS first hand. Since 2022, I've worked primarily as a snowboard instructor during the winter. That role frequently puts me in a position to accept cash tips. Since my bank doesn't have a location near where I live, and didn't allow cash deposits via ATM, I've made a practice of visiting the local post office to obtain money orders which I then deposit in my bank account via snail mail. Earlier this year, I sent a money order to my bank for deposit in my account. I paid extra at the Post Office counter for certified mail, since I knew I might need to track the deposit. In the past, such deposits were normally received my bank and credited to my account within days. This time, however, it took several times longer than that. When I noticed that it did not seem to have been received after a week, I checked the USPS website to track the package, learning only that delivery was still in process. I did so again on half a dozen other occasions, and ultimately waited three weeks for that check to be delivered. That's just a single anecdotal example, but it indicates the challenges facing even the delivery of certified mail. One might imagine that private services could conceivably replace the Postal Service, but none wield the scale necessary to perform all of its functions. If anything, shocks to the broader economy are cascading by limiting the ability of private corporations to deliver mail. For instance, the United Parcel Service (UPS) has plans to cut tens of thousands of jobs this year, citing not only abstract "changes in the global trade policy," but also specifically "new or increased tariffs". 7\. Degrading economic infrastructure: the FAA The Federal Aviation Administration performs several functions, including regulating air traffic control and setting minimum safety standards. Accidents involving airplanes have grown alarmingly frequent, driven to a large extent by staffing crises and government cuts made in the banner of suppressed efficiency that have instead sent travelers to early graves. Even after a fatal midair collision at Reagan National Airport that killed 67 people in January, the Trump administration , including personnel hired for maintaining radar, landing and navigational aids. The airport in Newark, NJ serving the New York metropolitan area has offered a of the predictable impacts. Jonathan Stewart, a veteran air traffic controller, was just last week to voice alarms with staffing and technology gaps. According to CNN, Stewart's concerns included "working multiple positions per shift to give other air traffic controllers breaks and having to write callsigns in a notebook out of fear of losing radar and radios." In his words, "Pushing people beyond their limits is not good business....I don't want to be responsible for killing 400 people." Technology issues have also impacted other airports, including , where air traffic controllers lost communications with airplanes in flight for over a minute last Monday, May 12. The Denver Air Route Traffic Control Center covers a massive expanse of airspace, encompassing 285,000 square miles across nearly ten states. 2025 has already emerged as the most deadly year in U.S. aviation in decades. Degrading public infrastructure that used to safeguard airplane safety effectively invites more blackouts, collisions, and even deaths. Beyond the direct impacts of those preventable events, a resulting chilling effect inhibiting other potential travelers has already carried further economic impacts that, to my knowledge, no one has yet quantified. 8\. Undermining Social Security could put legions of seniors on the streets Enacted during the Great Depression to provide an economic lifetime lifeline to struggling workers as they face replacement by younger workers, Social Security has played a vital function in allowing the poorest Americans to enjoy stability in their older years. The system has been operational for nearly 90 years and currently administers annual benefits totaling roughly $1.6 trillion in benefits to around 70 million Americans. All of them would struggle to survive should the solvency of the Social Security system become compromised. The solvency of the system over the long-term has been , but never has it faced threats as dire as those that confront it today. A Gallup poll released this spring found that are expressing "a great deal" of worry about the program's future, a 15-year high. Those concerns appear to be well-founded. According to workers at the Social Security Administration (SSA), staffing cuts and office closures have prompted "" and threaten to send the agency into a "death spiral." The agency's website has crashed several times this year, while public-facing phone services have been cut. Meanwhile, the Acting Commissioner has confirmed that DOGE staff are effectively running the SSA. One long-time agency worker and military veteran specifically criticized cuts recommended by the so-called Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE) once led by right wing industrialist Elon Musk, explaining that ". They're just coming up with ideas at the top of their head....Common sense is something they lack. They don't know what they're doing." According to a spokesperson for the American Federation of Government Employees' Social Security Administration general committee, the union representing over 40,000 social security workers, the current administration's cuts at the SSA represent " on the legitimacy of social security itself. The promise that this country has made to the public with respect to income security is being broken." Previous administrators of the system have warned that its solvency is in rapid decline, and warned the public in a recent Senate hearing about that could be made inevitable by staffing cuts and the closure of offices. Any suspension of benefits--however brief--could put millions of seniors on the streets. subject: Donald Trump’s “big, beautiful” bill
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
As the bill prepares for a vote, we need you to take action.
#

Team -- as you might’ve heard, Republicans are trying to ram through Donald Trump’s “big, beautiful” MAGA agenda in Congress.
If passed, the legislation would slash Medicaid, leave millions of people uninsured, and roll back critical safety nets -- all to hand tax cuts for Trump’s billionaire allies.
But there’s another thing it would do: **Republicans hid a provision in the text which would make gun silencers easier to obtain.**
Silencers make gunshots harder to hear and see -- making it more difficult for law enforcement to identify gunshots and locate active shooters. The only people that would benefit from silencers flooding the market are criminals and gun corporations who profit from these sales.
**So as the bill makes it way through Congress, we need you to help defeat this version AND stop leadership from making it even worse.**
[**We need you to call your Senators and tell them to put the needs of Americans above the interests of the gun lobby and billionaires. Will you please make a call today?**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_call_senator_may2025//?source=em250522-1-b&refcode2=10458.3935704.gzptCv&akid=10458%2E3935704%2EgzptCv)
*** Find the number for your Senators** [**here**](https://go.giffords.org/go/61963?t=1&akid=10458%2E3935704%2EgzptCv)*****
_Calling your member of Congress is one of the most effective ways to make your opinion heard!_
* * *
Hi, my name is _______, and I’m calling from Cresco.
_As a constituent, I demand that Congress put American lives first and oppose all efforts to make it easier to obtain gun silencers. A provision in this year’s budget proposal eliminates an almost 100-year-old tax on gun silencers—making it easier for anyone to get these deadly devices._
_Silencers have been used in mass shootings as well as assassin-style killings, and they undermine law enforcement’s ability to detect and respond to shootings._
_There is no reason to make it easier to purchase silencers, especially as widespread cuts are being made to programs and services that prevent gun violence. Can we count on Senator ______ to do the right thing?_
**[TELL US HOW IT WENT](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_call_senator_may2025//?source=em250522-1-b&refcode2=10458.3935704.gzptCv&akid=10458%2E3935704%2EgzptCv)**
If this GOP bill passes, it would put more money into the pockets of the gun industry while costing the US government nearly $1.5 billion over 10 years -- and ultimately, costing Americans their lives. We cannot let that happen.
[**Please make a call to your Senators today.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_call_senator_may2025//?source=em250522-1-b&refcode2=10458.3935704.gzptCv&akid=10458%2E3935704%2EgzptCv)
Thank you,
The team at GIFFORDS
**[DONATE](https://go.giffords.org/go/61968?t=2&akid=10458%2E3935704%2EgzptCv)**

Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.Giffords.org
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. We try to send only the most important information and opportunities to participate via email, but click [here](https://go.giffords.org/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?t=3&akid=10458%2E3935704%2EgzptCv) if you'd like to unsubscribe. Giffords PAC was started to support elected officials who step up to fight the gun violence epidemic. Thank you for standing with Gabby and the Giffords team.

Last week, South Carolina's Attorney General, Alan Wilson, joined me for a press conference.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fcb1f8f9-45d4-4c6e-ba7d-383474ac89d4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
He had accepted my invitation to make an announcement together.
That's two different states - and two different parties - standing together for one reason.
Folks, it's time to tell you about something I've been working on.
* * *
Fentanyl is the leading cause of death for people my age and younger. In North Carolina, we lose about six people a day.
It's really the third wave of the opioid crisis that began with OxyContin in the 1990s. That was the prescription pill crisis, which became the heroin crisis, which became the _synthetic_ heroin crisis, and that's fentanyl.
As AG, I've met a lot of families who have lost loved ones. It's crushing. And I have a responsibility to attack this problem on every front I can.
One of those fronts is illegal money laundering - the engine that makes the fentanyl trade so profitable. And I'm starting with a very big target.
## **How the Fentanyl Trade Works**
Here's a quick outline:
Step 1: Drug cartels in Mexico buy the chemical ingredients for fentanyl from China. Those ingredients are shipped to Mexico, mostly in large cargo ships but sometimes as regular air parcels via commercial carriers, like FedEx.
Step 2: The cartels mix those chemicals and produce fentanyl.
Step 3: The fentanyl is smuggled into the U.S., taken to various cities that serve as distribution hubs (often where highways intersect), then sold to dealers, who sell to users.
Step 4 _**(this is the money laundering part)**_ : The cash from the drug sales doesn't go back to Mexico - not directly. Instead, it's laundered through an underground banking network run by money brokers, often in China.
It's important to know that China limits how much money its citizens can move out of the country - no more than $50,000 a year. But many wealthy Chinese nationals want to move more.
So brokers in China connect the two markets: the cartel's drug traffickers in the U.S. and Chinese nationals who want to move their money out of the country and into U.S. dollars.
The broker accepts the cartel's drug money, finds someone who wants to get money out of China, and makes a match.
Then the broker essentially says, "Ok, Mr. Cartel Guy - this Chinese currency is now yours. You can now buy anything you want that is made in China and we'll ship it to you."
And once those goods (often cars and farm equipment) are shipped from China to Mexico, the cartels arrange for them to be sold into the domestic market for pesos, at which point they collect their profit.
How much money are we talking about here?
_Billions_.
## **The** _**WeChat**_**connection**
The evidence strongly suggests that the main platform used to facilitate that money laundering is an app called _**WeChat**_**.**
You've probably heard of WhatsApp. It's the largest text messaging app in the world.
Well, the second-largest text messaging app is WeChat. It's owned by a Chinese company and has over a billion users.
And when it comes to fentanyl money laundering, as one DEA agent said, "It's all happening on WeChat."
So I spent months digging into it. Talking with agents. Reading reports. When I felt like I had the full picture, I called five other attorneys general - two Democrats, three Republicans. I asked them to join me in stopping WeChat from being a safe harbor for money laundering.
They all agreed.
So we worked on our plan and last week we took the first step, which AG Wilson and I announced at our press conference (the other AGs were invited but live too far away to attend).
The first step is a public letter to WeChat summarizing some of the evidence about their complicity in a vast amount of money laundering and giving them 30 days to respond with a detailed account of steps they will now take to stop this.
If they fail to respond, we have a range of options for escalation.
But as I said at our press conference:
"Evidence suggests that WeChat has allowed itself to become an enormous digital pipeline for money laundering that fuels the fentanyl trade. By allowing that to continue, WeChat is essentially helping to bankroll the fentanyl epidemic. This must stop."
I'll let you know what we hear back, and that will determine next steps.
## **AmeriCorps lawsuit**
One more quick update:
We recently filed a lawsuit against the federal administration after it attempted to unlawfully defund AmeriCorps.
Congress authorized AmeriCorps funding, and the executive branch cannot unilaterally cut it.
But beyond that, it would have hit western North Carolina especially hard as it's rebuilding from Hurricane Helene. AmeriCorps has a strong presence there.
We had a hearing this week on a request for an injunction to stop the government from cutting this vital program. We expect to hear soon how the first round of that case will go.
Best,
Jeff

I’m sure you’ve noticed your energy bills increasing in recent years. Did you know that one of the reasons for this increase is the energy demand that large energy users like data centers are putting on the system? Yes, large energy users are adding to _your_ energy costs! Even though large energy users are using more energy, they are paying less for their energy than Oregon households and businesses. In fact it would amount to the **largest transfer of wealth from the poor to the rich in American history.**
Millions would lose their healthcare coverage. Millions of children would lose access to the food they need to survive. Families in every state and every Congressional district would struggle to make ends meet. Hundreds of thousands of working class jobs would be eliminated. But don’t worry: billionaires like Elon Musk will get a huge tax cut.
Once again, it’s a disgrace.
They say a budget is a statement of values. Well, this budget is a display of unfathomable heartlessness and greed from the GOP. And it’s a reminder of why Trump and the Republican party must be defeated.

President Trump and his Republican conspirators in Congress just pushed through a budget that **slashes $880 billion from Medicaid** , threatening healthcare access for working families and people with disabilities. The bill also cuts **$300 billion in assistance to buy groceries** through SNAP, taking food away from children, seniors, and working families. **1.4 million Oregonians** depend on the Oregon Health Plan. **775,000 Oregonians** rely on SNAP to put food on the table. But these aren’t just numbers to me. These are real people who will go hungry or choose not to go to a doctor when they’re sick. **All to fund tax breaks for the extremely wealthy. ** I’ve joined my fellow Democratic Governors around the country to speak out against the gutting of these critical programs — and now I hope you’ll join us. **[Take a stand with us, Peter. clean_body: | President Trump and his Republican conspirators in Congress just pushed through a budget that slashes $880 billion from Medicaid , threatening healthcare access for working families and people with disabilities. The bill also cuts $300 billion in assistance to buy groceries through SNAP, taking food away from children, seniors, and working families. 1.4 million Oregonians depend on the Oregon Health Plan. 775,000 Oregonians rely on SNAP to put food on the table. But these aren’t just numbers to me. These are real people who will go hungry or choose not to go to a doctor when they’re sick. All to fund tax breaks for the extremely wealthy. I’ve joined my fellow Democratic Governors around the country to speak out against the gutting of these critical programs — and now I hope you’ll join us. | If I know anything about the people of our state, it’s that Oregonians won’t stand by and watch our neighbors suffer. Thank you for being in this fight! name: Deb Haaland
subject: Can I tell you a story?
