body:
That’s what life in rural New Mexico can be like.
# [](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/133?t=1&akid=2115%2E400544%2EHzgI3G)
When I was a kid growing up in Laguna Pueblo, my mom had me go out to the car. I went outside, stuck the key in the door — _and broke it._ Right there in the lock!
We didn’t have a spare. No locksmith down the road. No second car in the driveway. So my mom walked _five miles_ to get a new key made.
**That’s what life in rural New Mexico can be like.** You make do. You lean on neighbors. You walk miles no one else sees.
Donald Trump and the out-of-touch billionaires running the show in Washington have _no idea_ what life in rural New Mexico is like. And right now, they’re pushing policies that will make life harder.
Trump’s tariffs are already jacking up costs. Now this morning, House Republicans passed Trump’s tax scam that cuts health care funding like Medicaid and slashes benefits New Mexicans rely on like SNAP. This budget is a disaster for New Mexicans and hurts our working families.
**Rural New Mexicans deserve better.[I’m running to be a governor who fights for all of our communities. If you can, I hope you’ll pitch in $5 to help us grow our campaign.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250522_1_rural?amount=5&refcode=em20250522-2115&refcode2=2115_400544_HzgI3G&akid=2115%2E400544%2EHzgI3G)**
I understand the challenges rural New Mexico faces because I’ve lived them.
I know what it’s like to grow up in a place where we cultivated corn in the summer and played on the mesas until the sun went down.
I’ve watched families piece together enough to buy groceries, drive hours for basic care, and do everything they can to hold on to their land, their dignity, and their future.
That’s why I’ll be a governor who ensures our rural communities have a seat at the table and a voice in shaping our future.
**But if Trump and Republicans flip New Mexico red, attacks on rural communities won’t just be coming out of Washington — they’ll also be policies coming out of the governor’s office. We can’t let that happen.**
**[So if you’re with me, please pitch in $5 to help us reach New Mexicans in every corner of the state and win this race.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250522_1_rural?amount=5&refcode=em20250522-2115&refcode2=2115_400544_HzgI3G&akid=2115%2E400544%2EHzgI3G)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_dh_20250522_1_rural?amount=5&refcode=em20250522-2115&refcode2=2115_400544_HzgI3G&akid=2115%2E400544%2EHzgI3G)**
Thank you for everything,
Deb

body:
It’s over a trillion dollars in tax breaks for people making more than $500,000 a year, and a trillion dollars in cuts to Medicaid and food assistance.
#

Peter, it’s almost hard to believe.
Many of the same Republicans who voted for the budget earlier this morning have promised their constituents they would not cut Medicaid.
Trump went directly to the House GOP earlier this week, and he told them in no uncertain terms not to mess with Medicaid.
And you know what’s in the budget they just passed? Massive cuts to Medicaid and food assistance.
Millions of people are projected to lose their health care, hospitals will close, and families will go without groceries if this bill passes.
Honestly, I have never seen anything like it.
I came to the United States Senate to fight for the people of my state. Two million Arizonans are on Medicaid, and hundreds of thousands of them will lose their coverage if this budget passes. Millions more around the country will lose it, too.
Now’s the time we earn our pay. I’m going to do what Arizona sent me to the Senate to do and work to stop this budget. And I’m going to continue traveling the country and speaking to anyone who will listen about the damage Trump and the GOP are trying to do to our country.

name: VoteVets.org
subject: Tell Congress to Stop Trump’s Birthday Parade
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY VOTEVETS, VOTEVETS
body:
It has a price tag of $45 million. 25 tanks, 50 helicopters, thousands of troops. And the centerpiece? At the end of the parade, Army paratroopers will make a jump and upon landing deliver an American flag to Trump — a birthday present for the dictator-in-chief.
#
During Trump's first-term, we organized and helped stop his repeated efforts to hold a military parade.
One time, we requested and were awarded a permit to host a 5-K road race on the parade route. One K for each of his deferments.
Trump’s at it again. It has a price tag of $45 million. 25 tanks, 50 helicopters, thousands of troops. And the centerpiece? At the end of the parade, Army paratroopers will make a jump and upon landing deliver an American flag to Trump — a birthday present for the dictator-in-chief.
This parade would be far from the national celebration that Trump claims, it would be an international embarrassment. His wishes for this event are not about celebrating the military, they are about his fragile self-image needing a public display of the military honoring him.
And he's doing it as the House and Senate work overtime to pass a budget that takes hundreds of billions of dollars from services Veterans depend on to pay for a tax cut for the richest people in the country.
No.
If this parade is going to be stopped, it'll be the voices of veterans who make it possible. But we can't do it alone.
[**Sign VoteVets petition: Tell Congress the American people believe a military parade would be a huge mistake, and that the military is not there to be used and abused to prop up the president's fragile self-image.**](https://act.votevets.org/signup/250503_vv_em_no_parade?source=em250522-1-full&akid=34419%2E3013755%2EKzLrjp)

name: Working Families Party
subject: House Republicans just passed their budget. Here's what happens next.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party PAC (77 Sands St
body:
They are the same party we always knew they were. | | | Peter, **In the dead of night last night, House Republicans rammed through their budget legislation to slash Medicaid, steal from working families, and give more money to the mega-rich.** The thousand-page bill ended up passing by a single vote early this morning, with House Democrats united in opposition. It now goes to the Senate, which will have its own process over the coming weeks. If the Republican budget ends up passing into law, it would mean 13 million people losing their health care coverage. It would mean a new job loss penalty for millions who rely on Medicaid, and an automatic half-trillion dollars in cuts to Medicare. Millions more would lose food assistance. All so the mega-rich can get more tax cuts. clean_body: They are the same party we always knew they were. | | | Peter, In the dead of night last night, House Republicans rammed through their budget legislation to slash Medicaid, steal from working families, and give more money to the mega-rich. The thousand-page bill ended up passing by a single vote early this morning, with House Democrats united in opposition. It now goes to the Senate, which will have its own process over the coming weeks. If the Republican budget ends up passing into law, it would mean 13 million people losing their health care coverage. It would mean a new job loss penalty for millions who rely on Medicaid, and an automatic half-trillion dollars in cuts to Medicare. Millions more would lose food assistance. All so the mega-rich can get more tax cuts. There’s been a lot of talk since the election about Republicans re-branding themselves as a “working class” party.** But the bill that just passed the House proves that Republicans are the same party we always knew they were — one that steals from working families in order to give more money to billionaires. Over the coming weeks and months, we will need to: 1. Do all we can to defeat this budget in the Senate and stop the worst parts of it from becoming law, 2. Prepare for 2026 and make sure House Republicans are held accountable for their betrayal of their own constituents by ending their majority, and 3. Grow our movement of working people coming together across our differences to stop the authoritarian right and fight for a country that works for all of us, at every level of government. Republicans are proving once again that they are about as far from a “working class” party as you can get. And over the decades, far too many Democrats have strayed toward the billionaire class as well. The SAVE Act was fast-tracked by opponents of voting rights and passed the U.S. House of Representatives. This bill is a stunning assault on our fundamental right to vote, and we can not afford to let this anti-democratic legislation become law, folks.
Don’t be fooled by the name. This bill would force every voter to present proof of citizenship to register -- something millions of eligible Americans don’t have on hand. And that’s the point.
The bill would also obliterate popular methods of voter registration for all voters, including:
* Registration by mail

* 3rd party voter registration drives

* Online voter registration in states that allow it

* Automatic voter registration
Some estimates say that this bill could disenfranchise up to 11 million eligible Americans , especially women and those who live in under-resourced communities.
“ There’s never been an attack on voting rights out of Congress like this ,” said Alexander Keyssar, a professor of History and Social Policy at the Harvard Kennedy School, and a leading historian of voting rights. “ It’s always been the federal government trying to keep states in check on voting rights, for the most part. ”

This bill offers nothing but higher costs and less health care for hardworking Americans who deserve better. It slashes $1 TRILLION from Medicaid, Medicare, food assistance programs like SNAP, and much more – all in favor of giving tax breaks to billionaires and big companies. I’m the son of refugees. My family survived thanks to programs like Medicaid and SNAP. I know what’s at stake and I refuse to let extreme Republicans play political games while families struggle. We have to stand up and fight – because our future is at stake. While I’m doing all I can from Congress, it’s clear that flipping the House next year is the best way to hold extreme Republicans accountable and stop the needless cuts. In solidarity, -Derek | = | www.derektranforcongress.com Use of Derek Tran's military rank, job titles, and photographs in uniform does not imply endorsement by the Dept. of Defense or U.S. Army. Derek Tran is a veteran, consumer rights attorney, and Member of Congress representing California's 45th District. subject: Republican cruelty is at an all-time high.

#

Team — it’s Mandela Barnes.
Last night the Republican House majority approved a budget plan that would be one of the cruelest pieces of legislation ever passed in the modern era. Experts say it would be the largest transfer of wealth from the poor to the wealthy in American history.
Over 13 million people would lose their Medicaid coverage, and at least 8 million would be left completely uninsured.
Over 18 million kids could lose access to free school meals that they rely on.
SNAP benefits face cuts of up to 30%, which would leave millions who live below the poverty line without the food assistance they need.
All while _lowering_ the tax bills of the wealthiest people on the planet — billionaires like Trump and Elon Musk.
**This entire fiasco shows why it’s vitally important to retake the House and Senate in next year’s midterm elections.**
If we had just a few more votes in the House, we could have stopped this bill from leaving the House. If we had just a few more votes in the Senate, we could block this bill from ever reaching Trump’s desk.
That’s why these elections matter. They are the difference between forward progress and huge steps backwards.

_**MSNBC: Republicans pass Trump bill while trying to hide Medicaid, SNAP cuts**_ Derek, Last night, Republicans in the House passed a budget plan that would rip away healthcare for millions, cut millions in food assistance for families, schools, and kids, and add trillions to the national debt. _All to pay for tax handouts to the ultra-wealthy and giant corporations._ This is a fiscally reckless attack on the basic needs of millions of Americans. It will likely make our country—including tens of thousands of people in Western Pennsylvania—sicker, poorer, and hungrier. **That’s why Chris Deluzio voted against this bill.** Tens of thousands of people in PA-17 could lose their healthcare through these cuts, and around 100,000 people in our district use monthly food assistance through SNAP, including thousands of children. If this $300 billion cut becomes the law, folks in Western Pennsylvania could go hungry. That’s why Chris knows this fight is not over. name: Sarah McBride
subject: There’s nothing big and beautiful about this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
This heinous bill includes the largest cut to Medicaid and the largest cut to food assistance in American history.
#
**Breaking news:**
Early this morning, House Republicans passed Donald Trump’s so-called “big beautiful” tax bill by a single vote, but there’s nothing beautiful about what they just did.
**This heinous bill includes the largest cut to Medicaid and the largest cut to food assistance in American history.** These are life-and-death programs for millions of Americans, and Republicans voted to gut them so they could give tax breaks to billionaires.
**That’s why I stood on the House floor at 2 AM to stop these cuts, and it’s why I voted no.**
Because this is personal.
It’s personal for my constituent Caroline, who told me that “without Medicaid, I will die.” It’s personal for the families in Delaware and across the country that rely on SNAP to feed their kids.
**Make no mistake: this fight is NOT over. Now this bill moves to the Senate, and the outcome will depend on how loudly and clearly we speak up _right now._**
[**If you believe no one should lose health care or go hungry so the super rich can get even richer, then rush a donation to help us fight back.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20250522-1?refcode=em20250522-2024&amount=5&refcode2=2024_21716_rWLPcy&akid=2024%2E21716%2ErWLPcy)

I’ll keep fighting. For Caroline, for Delaware, and for every family who needs a government that hears and sees them.
Let’s meet this moment.
— Sarah

name: Nicole Malliotakis
subject: One Big Beautiful Bill 🇺🇸
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NICOLE FOR NEW YORK (FEDERAL)
body:
Hi Friend, Early today, the House passed President Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill making the Trump Tax Cuts permanent and delivering additional tax relief for seniors and middle class families.

| | | | [](https://nicolemalliotakis.emlnk9.com/lt.php?x=3DZy~GE6J3ea5HV._g5GWOdw16IkudAkj~ZkYnfEKaHOEKBAyEy.0OFs2nNziNLwjNYwbHLFIXic)
---
| | | Hi Friend-
**Early today, the House passed President Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill making the Trump Tax Cuts permanent and delivering additional tax relief for seniors and middle class families.**
As a member of the House Ways and Means Committee, I’m proud of the work that went into passing this vital investment in the future of our country. Now, the Senate needs to act quickly and send this historic legislation to President Trump for his signature.
**Here’s a rundown of the key steps we took to enact President Trump’s agenda:**
---
| | | **Increase SALT and the Standard Deduction** Quadruples the State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction to $40,000 and raises the Standard Deduction to $16,300 for individuals and $32,600 for married couples building on the 2017 Tax Cuts and Jobs Act, which originally doubled the standard deduction.
---
| | |
---
| | | **Tax Relief for Seniors** Includes my legislation to provide a bonus deduction for seniors on Social Security—$4,000 for individuals earning up to $75,000 and $8,000 for married couples earning up to $150,000.
---
| | |
---
| | | **Tax Relief for Middle Class Families** Fulfills President Trump's commitment to eliminate taxes on tips and overtime, stops the return of the Alternative Minimum Tax that crushed middle-income families, makes the 2017 tax cuts permanent, and allows Americans to fully deduct auto loan interest on American-made vehicles.
The Big Beautiful Bill also makes adoption tax credits more accessible, expands 529 education savings accounts, supports scholarships and school choice, expands the Child Tax Credit to $2,500, and improves access to child care. The bill also includes my legislation to extend tax-free employer reimbursement for students and college graduates.
---
| | |
---
| | | **Protecting and Strengthening Medicaid** Safeguards New York’s most vulnerable Medicaid population by preserving the 50% federal reimbursement match, prevents illegal immigrants from receiving Medicaid benefits, eliminates PBM's abusive use of spread pricing in Medicaid, and cracks down on fraudsters by targeting waste, fraud, and abuse.
---
| | |
---
| | | **Keeps Our Borders Secure** Provides funding for the detention and deportation of criminal illegal immigrants, hires 10,000 new Border Patrol agents, constructs new border barriers and enforces the Remain in Mexico policy.
---
| | |
---
| | | **Revolutionizes Our National Security** Provides $12.5 billion to modernize our air traffic control system at Newark Airport and other facilities, funds the Golden Dome to help protect our homeland, invests in American shipbuilding to strengthen our naval fleet, and upgrades to our military to meet 21st-century threats.
---
| | |
---
| | | **Unleashes American Energy** Increases and strengthens domestic energy production and security. Saves billions in taxpayer money by rescinding wasteful spending from the Joe Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act.
---
| | |
---
**On behalf of President Trump, I want to thank you for the support you gave us as we passed this historic legislation.**
Please have a safe and healthy Memorial Day holiday with your family.
Sincerely,
Nicole Malliotakis
| |

The bill also includes my legislation to extend tax-free employer reimbursement for students and college graduates. | | | | | | Protecting and Strengthening Medicaid Safeguards New York’s most vulnerable Medicaid population by preserving the 50% federal reimbursement match, prevents illegal immigrants from receiving Medicaid benefits, eliminates PBM's abusive use of spread pricing in Medicaid, and cracks down on fraudsters by targeting waste, fraud, and abuse. | | | | | | Keeps Our Borders Secure Provides funding for the detention and deportation of criminal illegal immigrants, hires 10,000 new Border Patrol agents, constructs new border barriers and enforces the Remain in Mexico policy. | | | | | | Revolutionizes Our National Security Provides $12.5 billion to modernize our air traffic control system at Newark Airport and other facilities, funds the Golden Dome to help protect our homeland, invests in American shipbuilding to strengthen our naval fleet, and upgrades to our military to meet 21st-century threats. | | | | | | Unleashes American Energy Increases and strengthens domestic energy production and security. Saves billions in taxpayer money by rescinding wasteful spending from the Joe Biden’s Inflation Reduction Act. | | | On behalf of President Trump, I want to thank you for the support you gave us as we passed this historic legislation. Please have a safe and healthy Memorial Day holiday with your family. Sincerely, Nicole Malliotakis | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | | PAID FOR BY NICOLE FOR NEW YORK (FEDERAL) Sent to: dpwillis67@gmail.com Nicole for New York, PO Box 60487, Staten Island, NY 10306, United States

#
**Republicans gutted Medicaid while you were asleep last night.**
In the middle of the night, Republicans voted to kick 13.7 million Americans off their healthcare and stole food assistance from 11 million people in need to give tax cuts to billionaires:
Trump and Republicans in Congress are robbing people in order to hand it over to the rich. They are not in Congress to serve the people, they are here to serve themselves and the billionaires who have paid them—oligarchy.
_Trump fights for oligarchs and billionaires. Alexandria fights for us._
We are at a crossroads. We can either have extreme and growing wealth inequality with the toxic division and corruption that it requires to survive, or we can have a fair economy for working people along with a democracy and freedoms that uphold it.
Oligarchy or democracy, but we cannot have both.

clean_body: | | | | | | "Listening to Our Ancestors" | | Don't miss episode 4 of Slingshot the Podcast: “WTF Are They Doing?” — where the misunderstood voice becomes the culture’s power is hosted by our Founding CEO, Kadida Kenner, and Charles Gregory , from Every day feels like a new headline designed to distract us—and this week, Slingshot The Podcast is cutting through the noise. >From floating illegal ideas like sending U.S. citizens to foreign prisons , to reintroducing child labor , to defunding the Department of Education and college DEI programs , hosts Kadida Kenner and Charles Gregory break down the chaos with clarity and urgency. This isn’t conspiracy. This is the long game—strategized, intentional, and already in motion. In this episode: Why talk of imprisoning U.S. citizens abroad violates the Constitution The dangerous rise of child labor and the targeting of immigrant workers How gutting public education and DEI policies is about power—not policy A clear breakdown of how to protect your rights and freedoms before it’s too late The “3-person hack” to pressure your elected officials into action This episode is loud, unfiltered, and unapologetically real—because the distractions are working, and it's time we fight back with facts. I write to you today tired, bleary-eyed, but no less determined.
Early this morning, House Republicans passed President Trump's big, ugly bill while most of the country slept. They started debating it yesterday at 1 a.m. -- literally under the cloak of darkness.
That's because they don't want their constituents to know that it will:
* Raise the deficit by $3 trillion
* Cut taxes for the rich, but increase costs for middle and lower-income families
* Strip healthcare from nearly 14 million Americans
* Jeopardize food security for the 42 million Americans who rely on SNAP
For more than 30 hours, I was in the fight -- taking to the House floor at 4 a.m. to urge my colleagues to vote against this morally bankrupt bill. I waited more than 12 hours to offer one of 520 Democratic amendments to block the worst of its damange.
And we're not giving up. The Senate still has to pass it. And if the Senate makes changes, it will come back to the House again. We will be ready.
Will you contribute today to help me make sure this bill never becomes law? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/joc-2025?refcode=1.3]
I am, always, grateful for your support.

---
| Washington’s reckless spending is **spiraling out of control** , and hardworking Americans like you are footing the bill. **That’s why I’ve renewed my commitment to you by signing the Taxpayer Protection Pledge once again, opposing any and all tax increases.**

__**But I didn’t just sign a piece of paper.**__ I recorded a video explaining why this fight matters and why I need you with me.

[👉 **[WATCH MY MESSAGE HERE]**](https://electdavidflippo.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9aba26b775663b53df718fc1a&id=f6feb105d8&e=273c9a71fb)

---
| Every day, politicians in D.C. betray the American people by raising taxes, ignoring waste, and saddling future generations with debt.__**I refuse to be part of the problem**__. By signing this pledge, I’m forcing Washington to face the truth: **We don’t have a revenue problem—we have a spending crisis.

This isn’t just about numbers on a page. It’s about your paycheck, your family’s future, and your freedom.**

After you watch the video, I hope you’ll stand with me. Together, we can demand accountability, slash wasteful spending, and keep more money where it belongs—in your pocket.

I had to reach out right away with some big news, null: **I am honored and humbled to share that Nancy Pelosi just officially endorsed my campaign for Senate.**
It's been a privilege to serve in the House alongside a trailblazer and leader as inspiring as the former speaker. I have long looked to her as _the_ example to follow when it comes to getting things done for Michigan families, and her support means the world to me.
**[Will you join Nancy Pelosi in supporting my campaign by rushing $5 or more right now to keep Michigan blue and take back the Senate for Democrats?](https://act.haleyformi.com/go/2794?t=2&akid=167%2E49239%2E23jcfY)**

name: Susan Daggett Bennet
subject: Friend, we'd love you on our team.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Bennet for Governor
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250522_susanbennetsend_actrs [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250522_susanbennetsend_actrs]
Hi friends,
It's Susan, Michael’s wife. I wanted to reach out about what’s driving Michael to run for governor.
I’ve known Michael for more than 30 years. In that time, I’ve learned that he has a deeply held sense of responsibility to Colorado, this country, and the world.
As a result, he’s always been tireless in his effort to address issues, fix problems, and take action that will better the lives of those around him, especially Colorado’s kids.
Because of his drive to make a difference, Michael has a history of taking on jobs with tough—some would say impossible—challenges. When our daughters were young, Michael left a job in the private sector to work for the brand-new mayor of Denver and finally fix the city’s budget crisis.
Then, he took on the job of Superintendent of the Denver Public Schools, where he led one of the most significant educational reform initiatives in America that dramatically improved outcomes for kids.
Michael never expected to become a Senator, but he knew that being in the Senate was an opportunity to make an even bigger impact on Colorado and the next generation. He has spent the last 16 years traveling every inch of Colorado—studying the challenges Colorado communities face, the forces that threaten to pull us apart, and the values that promise to bring us together.
Now, Michael is running to be the next Governor of Colorado—because he knows the solutions to our most pressing challenges will come from right here at home.
Michael believes that Colorado is where we can build the future. Working together, we can create more affordable housing across the state, make healthcare and childcare more affordable and accessible, modernize our education system, support our small businesses, and continue leading the fight against climate change.
I’ve never been more proud of Michael, and I know he will be an extraordinary Governor of our extraordinary state.
That’s why I’m reaching out to you, friend. This campaign relies on thousands of small-dollar donations to keep it moving forward. If you can, please consider chipping in before their May end-of-month fundraising deadline. >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_mfb_email-25q2-g?refcode=X_250522_susanbennetsend_actrs]

clean_body: [] Hi friends, It's Susan, Michael’s wife. I wanted to reach out about what’s driving Michael to run for governor. I’ve known Michael for more than 30 years. In that time, I’ve learned that he has a deeply held sense of responsibility to Colorado, this country, and the world. As a result, he’s always been tireless in his effort to address issues, fix problems, and take action that will better the lives of those around him, especially Colorado’s kids. Because of his drive to make a difference, Michael has a history of taking on jobs with tough—some would say impossible—challenges. When our daughters were young, Michael left a job in the private sector to work for the brand-new mayor of Denver and finally fix the city’s budget crisis. Then, he took on the job of Superintendent of the Denver Public Schools, where he led one of the most significant educational reform initiatives in America that dramatically improved outcomes for kids. Michael never expected to become a Senator, but he knew that being in the Senate was an opportunity to make an even bigger impact on Colorado and the next generation. He has spent the last 16 years traveling every inch of Colorado—studying the challenges Colorado communities face, the forces that threaten to pull us apart, and the values that promise to bring us together. Now, Michael is running to be the next Governor of Colorado—because he knows the solutions to our most pressing challenges will come from right here at home. Michael believes that Colorado is where we can build the future. Working together, we can create more affordable housing across the state, make healthcare and childcare more affordable and accessible, modernize our education system, support our small businesses, and continue leading the fight against climate change. I’ve never been more proud of Michael, and I know he will be an extraordinary Governor of our extraordinary state. That’s why I’m reaching out to you, friend. # Meet Steve Hilton
---
I love California so much. I moved to the Bay Area over a decade ago. I’ve raised my family here, taught at Stanford, started a business, written books, hosted a TV show ... lived the California dream. It’s my home, in the deepest sense. I’m a proud American, and an incredibly proud Californian too. But I’ve never forgotten where I came from. My parents were immigrants – they fled communism in Hungary to start a new life in England. In a free country. I appreciate exactly what that means.We didn’t have much money. My mother worked in a shoe store, my stepfather worked construction. My dad, who died when I was a kid, was the goalie for the Hungarian national ice hockey team. In 2012 we moved to California. I hosted a TV show — The Next Revolution with Steve Hilton — and podcasts: California Rebel Base, The Steve Hilton Show, Big Ideas Book Club. Through my policy organization, Golden Together, I’ve set out the changes we need to make to get this state back on track. Over the last few years, I’ve traveled the state, meeting people from all walks of life and backgrounds, in every part of California. I’ve spent time with business owners and workers in every industry, struggling with the absolute nightmare it’s become to start and grow a company here. I’ve seen the struggles so many Californians face raising a family given the unbelievable costs of living here. To make real change happen in government, you need the ability to think differently, the courage to challenge establishment groupthink and the conviction to follow through. That’s what I will bring to this job – to the urgent necessity of restoring the California Dream for everyone, and making this beautiful state, that we love so much, truly Golden Again.
---

name: Chris Brooks, LCV
subject: BREAKING: House votes 215-214 to gut clean energy, drive up energy costs, give handouts to polluters and shred the safety net
body:
To view this mail in a browser, copy https://links.messages.lcv.org/servlet/MailView?ms=MTI1MTY0NDUS1&r=NjA3MDU0MTAzNTc3S0&j=MjIyMDI4MjA2NQS2&mt=1&rt=0 into your browser.
Peter — just hours ago, in the dead of night, the House of
Representatives voted 215-214 to pass a bill that would gut clean energy
production, drive up families’ costs, and allow polluters to bypass key
environmental safeguards and drill on our public lands. This is Trump’s so-called “big, beautiful bill” covering virtually every harmful
MAGA priority, from cutting healthcare for low-income people, to slashing pay
for federal workers, to building the racist environmentally-damaging border
wall, to giving handouts to fossil fuel executives and sabotaging the clean
energy industry. We need your help.This bill still needs to pass in the Senate, where Republicans hold a narrow
majority. We’re already hearing that many senators are skeptical of the bill’s most extreme provisions, which means
that we have a real shot at pressuring them to change course. We have to act quickly, Peter. Please, renew your LCV membership to help power our response today. Right now, $5 is all it takes >> https://links.messages.lcv. Our campaign to protect people and the planet from Trump’s anti-environmental
billionaire tax scam needs to ramp up NOW.We’re mobilizing nationwide, building grassroots power, and making sure the
inboxes and voicemails of every senator are full each day. We HAVE to make it
clear that senators will pay a political price if they vote to sell off public
lands, end environmental safeguards, and raise energy costs. Here are just a few of the stakes if this bill becomes law: Selling off public lands: the House’s bill mandates the sale and leasing of millions of acres of public lands and oceans — including sensitive ecosystems like the Arctic — for destructive oil, gas, and coal drilling, logging, and mining. Renew your LCV membership for just $5 to protect public lands >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/YYbZBxr-
Gutting clean energy production: the bill eliminates critical programs to expand clean energy and energy efficiency, sabotaging the transition to a sustainable economy and raising Americans’ energy costs. We cannot afford to reverse course on climate progress — $5 is all it takes to renew your LCV membership >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/EZ_
Ending environmental safeguards for oil and gas: this legislation would allow oil and gas executives to circumvent environmental review, guaranteeing approval for projects that have been proven to threaten our health and our climate and ripping away the public’s right to our day in court. You can help stop it by renewing your LCV membership today for just $5 >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/X6bzs~Ra_ Peter, we have a real opportunity to limit the damage this legislation
does to our environment, our health, and our climate. If only a small number of
Republican senators — some of whom have already publicly opposed the bill’s most
extreme provisions — vote no, there won’t be a majority to pass it. But the truth is that campaigns like these require resources that we just don’t
have right now. We really need your help to go as big as we need to win. So, we’re asking: Renew your LCV membership today for just $5. You’ll make an immediate impact for our environment and our health. Please don’t wait — we have only a brief window of opportunity before the Senate votes >> https://links.messages.lcv.org/els/v2/gryxf4e~ Thanks for standing with us, Peter. Chris Brooks
Vice President of Membership
League of Conservation Voters This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. If you missed today's _Amped Up_ , you missed one hell of a safari through the rotting guts of Republican-dictated dysfunction--with much gallows humor to go around.
I was joined by the always Emmy-worthy David Schuster and the razor-sharp Jonathan Larsen of _The Fucking News_ fame (yes, it's real, and brilliant). We started light--some solid ribbing, a few laughs about old-school "teabagger" puns--but then dove headfirst into the economic house of horrors that is Trump's "Big Beautiful Bill" scam.
Spoiler: It's neither beautiful nor a bill, it's a hand grenade--or something containing a bit more shrapnel, like a Trump steak--that horrid House Republicans lobbed into the very guts of Medicare, working people's wallets, and the basic concept of our democratic process.
Jonathan broke down how MAGA Republicans passed a thousand-plus-page monstrosity with a 40-page midnight amendment--jammed through in the middle of the night while the country was nodding off like Donald Trump at a meeting with the Saudis. **Let 's be clear:** What Squeaker Johnson did is what cowards do when they know the public would burn the damn thing if they had time to read it.
**They 're gutting public education to fund tax breaks for their rich pals who send their kids to private schools.** **They 're triggering a $500 billion cut to Medicare under PAYGO.** And they're doing it all while gaslighting the public about a _Moody 's credit downgrade_ that was a direct response to Trump's economic treason. That in the near future will transform the lives most Americans have grown accustomed to into a disappearing act for once-affordable basics. as America's starved of investment and the dollar crashes due to this dementia-addled, Stage-9 heffer.
Meanwhile, Trump's treating business like it's a mob front--threatening Walmart into silence, lying about $5 trillion in "promises" from Qatar (whose entire GDP is $200 billion, so his calculation only works at Trump University and in MTG's synapses). **And causing such chaos with tariffs that companies like Walmart won 't even give quarterly projections.**
You know it's bad when Wall Street--where quite a few executives who throw a party every time a company fires 10,000 people--starts to panic about Trump's instability and doofus-ry. And, shit, that's just the first half of the long-term dangers posed to our economy that we discussed on the show (be sure to watch!)
**Bottom line:** this isn't just about budgets or bond yields. As we discussed, it's about whether democracy can survive a party that has become more Yuri Andropov than Ronald Reagan (the irony). A cretinous entity that passes laws in the dark of night for a feeble, fatuous cult leader who thinks he's a king. And if Democrats don't start using power they're constitutionally provided with he same aggressiveness the GOP _abuses power they don 't actually have_, we'll lose the whole damn thing. By that, I mean it all.
Stay amped. Stay angry. And for the love of all that's decent, fight this "bill" by calling your elected representatives, posting your thoughts online, showing up at an office to protest...hell, sending up smoke signals in morse code if you have to.
But as our final plea during this convo on "Amped Up w/ Cliff Schecter" should've made clear, this is _**" a plan to starve American children and let us die without health insurance so Elon Musk can buy his fifth $78 million plane."**_ I've been in this business a while, and this is easily the most cruel, corrupt, and, yes, criminal act cosplaying as legislation that I've ever seen. EVER.

Secretary of State Marco Rubio **[fired back at California Congresswoman Sara Jacobs](https://substack.com/redirect/3a474acf-1462-46fb-9467-d5fe3092afd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after she called President Donald Trump corrupt during a tense foreign affairs hearing.
He didn't let her get away with it, _" That's false!" _
[Watch Video](https://substack.com/redirect/3a474acf-1462-46fb-9467-d5fe3092afd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
[](https://substack.com/redirect/3a474acf-1462-46fb-9467-d5fe3092afd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Jacobs gave a Trump Derangement Syndrome sermon, accusing the president of capitalizing on positive foreign relations with the UAE to line his own business' pockets.
"We have a president who is personally profiting from a deal with a foreign government backed company, at the same time he is selling lethal weapons to that same government. Isn't that a clear conflict of interest?" the congresswoman asked Rubio.
The deal in question is the Trump family's recent dealings with the UAE, coming off his four day stint in the Middle East where his main objective was to broker investments for the betterment of the U.S.
"I think no matter who was the president, they would have to deal with the UAE." Rubio answered Jacobs.
Jacobs immediately went to undermining the Secretary. "That's not my question!!"

clean_body: [TAKE THE POLL] Peter, when asked if he, as president, needs to uphold the Constitution — Donald Trump responded, “I don’t know.” Let’s be clear: Every elected official in this country, from local school board members to the President of the United States, swears an oath to uphold the Constitution. It’s not a suggestion. It’s a fundamental requirement. Our Constitution outlines the freedoms we hold dear, it limits government overreach, it ensures checks and balances, and it holds our leaders accountable. For the current sitting president to shrug off his duty to our nation’s most sacred document isn’t just careless—it's beyond dangerous. We simply cannot allow anyone who disregards the rule of law to lead this country. That’s why we're asking: Thank you for using your voice, Kim Schrier for Congress Rep. Kim Schrier is a doctor, scientist, and mom, fighting for Washington's 8th District in Congress. This is one of the most competitive districts in the country, so we need your help to keep Kim in Congress. **One of my top supporters was The Atlas Society.**

_I will also tell you HOW The Atlas Society is spreading its message in what I consider one of the most innovative methods I 've EVER seen a nonprofit organization engage in before._

_**_So keep reading_!**_

My mentor, Andrew Breitbart, reminds us that politics is downstream from culture. But what is culture downstream from? Answer: Philosophy. That's where The Atlas Society shines, engaging young people with the virtues of reason, achievement, and benevolent self-interest in wildly creative, artistic ways.

Have you ever read Ayn Rand's _Atlas Shrugged_ or _The Fountainhead_?

These books changed how I saw the world and my role in it.

But they are 700+ pages long!

**Jennifer shared this terrifying statistic with me:** Daily reading of books among young people has fallen from 70% in the late 1970s to 12% today.

So, how do we preserve Rand's role as the greatest all-time recruiter for liberty? That's where The Atlas Society gets creative! They leverage art and technology to create programming for "_skimmers, swimmers, and deep divers_."

**Skimmers:** Social media memes and animated videos -- every single one of their 50 posts a week gets 40K comments, shares, and likes. The "Draw My Life" videos on concepts like Capitalism, Property Rights, and Free Speech reach MILLIONS of viewers. Links invite young people on a journey for deeper intellectual exploration.

**Swimmers:** Graphic novel adaptations of Ayn Rand's shorter books, Pocket Guides that distill big concepts like Postmodernism and Socialism into a 90-minute read. Weekly podcasts with top entrepreneurs and thought-leaders, and discussion groups like "Morals & Markets."

**Deep Divers:** They recruited an all-star academic faculty of philosophers and economists who guide students on a deeper study of Rand's philosophy, publish independent work, and provide programming at their summer conference for students (the Galt's Gulch Summit, where I spoke!).

million people off their health insurance, end federal Pell Grants for

# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20250522-1&t=1&akid=2165%2E587540%2EjhaPyr)
Peter, this is not a drill. **_It’s a five-alarm fire for our democracy._** 🚨
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250522_1_habeascorpus?refcode=em20250522-2165&amount=5&refcode2=2165_587540_jhaPyr&akid=2165%2E587540%2EjhaPyr)
The White House actually admitted that they are looking into suspending habeas corpus. **If this is allowed to move forward, Donald Trump could arrest anyone and imprison them indefinitely without charges or a trial.** This is pure insanity.
It’s hard to believe this is an actual conversation that we’re having in our country. This administration is trampling all over the fundamental values that have made this country a beacon of freedom in the world. They want nothing more than to turn Donald Trump into a king who can do as he pleases – including disappearing people off the streets and denying them the constitutional right to due process.
Meanwhile, just this week, Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem was unable to correctly define habeas corpus in a Senate hearing, falsely referring to it as the president’s constitutional right to remove people from the country. Utterly insane.
**Peter, shit like this is one of the main reasons I am so fired up about the work we’re doing at Leaders We Deserve.** We are providing a much-needed boost to the next generation of bold, progressive leaders who will not only fight like hell against the Trump-MAGA agenda, but also offer a better vision for the future.
We can turn the page on crooked politicians like Trump who are ransacking our government and getting rich off of our backs – and we can replace them with young progressive champions who will remake the system to work for all of us.
But we’re only going to make that vision a reality with your continued support. **[If you can, please make a $5 contribution now to help power our mission.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em_ms_lwd_20250522_1_habeascorpus?refcode=em20250522-2165&amount=5&refcode2=2165_587540_jhaPyr&akid=2165%2E587540%2EjhaPyr)**

Thank you for standing with us,
David

Dear ,

I’m reaching out to introduce you to my friends and colleagues at Freedom Virginia, an organization that works to elect progressive champions in Virginia’s state elections. Next Wednesday, May 28th, I will be honored as one of Freedom VA’s two Legislators of the Year for my work on Paid Family Leave here in the Commonwealth, and I’d love for you to join me.

Please join next Wednesday, May 28th from 5:30 - 7:00 PM at the home of Peter Appel in McLean to celebrate with me and to learn more about Freedom Virginia’s work to use data-informed messaging to reach voters and win elections this November.

Below is the official invitation, you can reserve your spot using this link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/freedomva528

Please note that while contributions are appreciated, they are not required to attend.

If you have any questions about the event or to RSVP, please reach out to events@freedomva.org

I hope to see you there!

Yours in service,

Briana Sewell

# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20250522-5070-footer&t=1&akid=5070%2E420207%2ExebPGz)
Peter, I'm furious.
House Republicans, under the cloak of darkness, just passed a massive giveaway to billionaires, paid for by stealing from the poor. Their big ugly bill strips 14 million people off their health care and slashes food for the hungry and cuts basic needs.
If you’re in the top one percent, you do well in this bill – but if you’re a poor or working person, you get screwed. **I voted no because I stand with the people, not the billionaires.**
Donald Trump and the Republicans in Congress have made it clear that they will ALWAYS put their billionaire donors ahead of working people — which is why it’s so important that we do everything we can to fight back.
I’m organizing both inside and outside of Congress to make sure folks know what’s at stake, but I need you with me, Peter.

“My country expects me to move further, faster, and fight harder than any other.”
“I will shoulder more than my share of the task, whatever it may be, 100% and then some.”
“Under no circumstances will I ever embarrass my country.”

9/11 changed the lives of so many Americans, including mine. I made the decision to transition from the National Guard to active duty, and I served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan.

My three tours taught me a lot about respect, working under pressure, and the value of selfless service to others.

clean_body: Jason Crow For Congress [] If there’s one thing you should know about me, it’s that I’ve never forgotten the creed I lived by when I served as an Army Ranger. And now that I'm a member of Congress, that creed still shapes who I am. Here are a few parts that are especially meaningful to me: “My country expects me to move further, faster, and fight harder than any other.” “I will shoulder more than my share of the task, whatever it may be, 100% and then some.” “Under no circumstances will I ever embarrass my country.” 9/11 changed the lives of so many Americans, including mine. I made the decision to transition from the National Guard to active duty, and I served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan. My three tours taught me a lot about respect, working under pressure, and the value of selfless service to others. [] But now, our nation is facing a different fight. Our constitutional rights are under attack. Our economy is slowing because of Donald Trump’s trade war and tariff taxes on working families. We need to hold the Trump administration accountable. In addition to helping shape the redistricting process, elections this year will make a difference for the future of core freedoms.
Just take a look at Virginia. Races this year will determine whether major constitutional amendments can move forward in 2026:
* **The Right to Reproductive Freedom** | Right now, Virginia is the _last_ state in the southern region that hasn’t implemented a post-Roe abortion ban.
* **Remove Constitutional Same-Sex Marriage Ban** | Yes, this is _still_ a thing in the Virginia Constitution.
* **Voting Rights Restored for Felons Upon Release** | Fighting for a truly representative democracy includes fighting for EVERY eligible voter to be able to make their voice heard.

Trump’s budget would kick millions of people from their health insurance and literally take food out of children’s mouths — all in favor of putting more money in the pockets of billionaires. This is bad, really bad. And while Schweikert has been asleep at the wheel, Marlene has been in the community listening to how this budget would hurt Arizona families. = | = Schweikert has had plenty of chances to fight for Arizona families, but consistently chooses to put party over people. Peter,

My name is Adam Schwarze, and I’m a former Navy SEAL, Marine Corps veteran, and proud Minnesotan **running for U.S. Senate against Tim Walz’s handpicked lieutenant governor—a politician even more radical than her boss.** I’m requesting your support in this critical battle to restore common-sense conservative values to Minnesota.

I hold a Master’s from Harvard, a Master’s Certificate from Johns Hopkins in Security and Nuclear Deterrence, and an MBA. But my proudest achievement is serving our country to make my parents, especially my mom, proud. I want to serve you in the U.S. Senate, fighting for the values that have made Minnesota and America great for generations.

name: Jacky Rosen
subject: re: The GOP’s Medicaid cuts
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rosen for Nevada
body:
We need to save health care for millions of Americans
| | |
---
This is despicable, friend:
**FIRST:** Donald Trump and Republicans _repeatedly_ said they wouldn't cut Medicaid.
**THEN: **House Republicans passed a budget that will slash Medicaid – after Senate Republicans said their first proposal didn’t go far enough!
**NOW:_Nearly 14 million people could lose their health coverage._**

body:
It’s Andie Levien, the General Counsel at the DNC.
---
Derek, I’m Andie, the DNC’s General Counsel — which means it’s my job to oversee all legal issues related to the Party’s work, **including taking Trump and DOGE to court.** This year, we’ve taken Trump to court twice, once for his attempt to take over the FEC — the independent watchdog that oversees federal campaigns — and again in response to his executive order attempting to suppress voters, hand over sensitive information to DOGE, stop states from counting eligible mail ballots, and withhold federal election funding from dozens of states in the process. These illegal power grabs threaten our democracy. That’s why we filed these lawsuits. **And it’s why I'm writing to ask you to make a $3 donation to the DNC.** $3, that's the ask. $3 to hold Trump and Musk accountable in court. $3 to support Democrats’ aggressive defense of our elections, our democracy, and our right to vote. $3 to allow us to use every tool at our disposal — _including seeing these lawsuits all the way through and taking Trump to court as many times as we need_ — to stop Trump’s power grabs. [**Winning these cases is not easy, especially when your opponents are the president and the richest man in the world. So we rely on supporters like you to help fund this work. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: This is sickening
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
This will be the greatest transfer of wealth from the poor to the billionaires in all of US History.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2557%2E4032634%2EQ1noE0)
---
I am really, really angry. Elon Musk and Jeff Bezos are out there popping bottles of champagne that cost more than someone’s monthly rent because of what Republicans just did. In the dead of night, Republicans in the House just passed Trump’s “big, beautiful” spending plan. If this gets signed into law, this will be the greatest transfer of wealth from the poor to the billionaires in all of US History. They essentially just spent this past week debating whether 14 million people should lose their health care, or if 20 million people should lose their health care. Whether 10 million babies should go hungry, or 5 million babies should be hungry. All so the government can hand that money over to billionaires through tax giveaways. Billionaires like Elon Musk, who had his net worth grow $186 billion in the last year and is on track to become the world’s first trillionaire. He and his peers in the “Top 10 Richest Americans Club” together became $365 billion richer in the past year. That’s a billion a day. That’s who this bill is for. That’s who has the most to gain from this legislation. That’s what they are getting for bending the knee to Trump. It’s sick. It will raise prices for everyone who Trump promised he would lower costs for. Workers who made an annual average of $50,000 in 2023. So, what’s next? We need to do everything in our power to stop this from passing the Senate. This isn’t a done deal yet. The last time we came together when Trump tried to repeal health care, we stopped him. Americans told their stories and raised their voices — with disabled activists literally putting their bodies on the line in the halls of Congress. It _mattered_. Even though the Republican House voted to repeal the Affordable Care Act, even though they popped over to celebrate on the White House lawn, even though they may have thought they had it in the bag, we kept fighting back, and we defeated them. I know we can do this. We have to. Don’t let anyone tell you it won’t make a difference to speak out. I’ll be in touch on the ways we can fight back on this. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

The day Robert asked for my daughter’s hand in marriage was one of the proudest days of my life. I couldn’t have chosen a better man for my baby girl if I tried. Even though we lost my daughter in 2020 after a long battle with breast cancer, Robert and I have remained close. He’s like a son to me and there’s nothing I won’t do for him. **[That’s why I’m swallowing my pride and asking you, a perfect stranger, for help.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-tXw/s7hcfa0db74)** Let me tell you what happened so you can decide if you’ll join me in fighting for an innocent man... Last September, Robert stopped to assist a vehicle that appeared to be broken down. As he stepped out of his police car, a man walked right in front of Robert. But when Robert asked if he was with the disabled car, the man did not stop or even acknowledge him. **Then suddenly, the man pivoted to face Robert and stretched his right hand away from his body with a black object in his hand.** If you’ve spent any time around law enforcement officers, then you know they are trained to quickly assess a situation and take necessary action to defend themselves. Robert didn’t know why this car was pulled to the side of the road -- nor did he know who was in it. But he knew that traffic stops are one of the most dangerous situations for a cop to respond to -- so when this man appeared to pull a gun on him, Robert didn’t hesitate. He fired one shot. The bullet did not strike the man. Thank goodness, as Robert later discovered he was unarmed! Why the man pulled out his cell phone and pointed it at my son-in-law, we may never know... But the bottom line is _no one was hurt._ **Unfortunately, that didn’t stop the local prosecutor from swooping in and charging Robert with** **_Attempted Murder_.** It didn’t make any sense until we learned the prosecutor was backed by George Soros and she was campaigning for higher office on an anti-cop platform. Surely prosecuting a decorated police officer would win over the radical base here in left-leaning Prince George’s County, Maryland. Like I said at the beginning of my letter, it’s a political witch-hunt. Robert’s trial is scheduled for September 2025. **He faces up to 30 years in prison.** My son-in-law has already lost so much. I can’t sit idly by and watch a radical prosecutor steal his career away from him, too. **[That’s why I’m humbly asking you to make a donation to help pay for Robert’s legal defense.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-tXw/sflfa6c5f25) ** I’m going to be blunt. The attorneys anticipate it’ll cost over $150,000 to get through the trial. Robert just doesn’t have that kind of money. It was difficult enough to pay the medical bills following my daughter’s four-year battle with cancer on a police officer’s salary. I’ve helped as much as I can, and I was starting to worry when we got a call from a local man named Jason Johnson. It turns out Jason is a retired Prince George’s County Police Officer. And now he runs the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF). It was truly an answer to a prayer. For over thirty years, the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF) has provided legal defenses to wrongly accused police officers like Robert. They pay for attorneys’ fees, expert witnesses, investigators, other court costs, and more. LELDF has successfully helped hundreds of officers clear their names and win back their freedom. And now they’re helping Robert mount the defense he deserves. But they can’t do it alone. **[That’s why I’m praying you’ll find it in your heart to help LELDF fight for Robert.](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-tXw/sav17352070)** It may not seem like your gift of $35, $50, or even $100 will make a difference with that huge of a sum. But when combined with donations from thousands of other folks who are moved by our story, LELDF will be able to raise the resources to pay for Robert’s case. [**Will you please help fight for Robert by donating $35, $50, $100, or more to LELDF today?**](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-tXw/s2q845b7590) LELDF is a non-profit organization which means your gift today is tax-deductible. And you can rest assured your gift will be put to immediate use helping Robert and other wrongly accused officers win in court and move on with their lives as free men. Frankly, I was shocked to learn LELDF is supporting several officers who are also being railroaded by Soros-backed anti-cop prosecutors. It’s unconscionable! As a father, I wish more than anything that I could snap my fingers and make this all go away for Robert. But since I can’t, I’m doing what any father would do – I’m fighting for my son with all I’ve got. So no matter what you’re able to give to LELDF today, please pray for Robert and our family. We really need some good news right now. Thank you in advance for your generous support.
---
Gratefully,
---
Mark Jennings
---
P.S. I saw Robert’s true character while my daughter -- his wife -- battled breast cancer. He is a good man who would lay down is life for another without hesitation. Five years after my daughter’s death, I still consider Robert my son and there’s nothing I won’t do for him. Our family has already lost so much. Robert’s freedom and good name -- not to mention his career -- are on the line. Please don’t let a desperate Soros-backed prosecutor steal all he has left. **[Help us fight back by donating $35, $50, $100, or more to the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund today](https://link.email.freethinkerdaily.-tXw/sdoc3e5e814).** Thank you!

Derek: Today, the House passed their version of the federal budget.
It’s a disaster of a bill.
The GOP budget would slash critical programs like Medicaid, throwing more than 262,000 Virginians off their health care. It would gut the Inflation Reduction Act, jeopardizing thousands of jobs in Virginia alone. And it would make life more expensive at a time when costs are already sky-high — all so Trump can hand trillions of dollars in tax cuts to the wealthy and massive corporations.
So let’s talk about what will happen next, and how you can help stop this terrible bill:
Now that the House passed their budget, it will come to the Senate for us to consider.
Republican leadership in the Senate plans to use reconciliation to consider the bill, which is a special process that allows the Senate to pass legislation with a simple majority (instead of the usual 60 votes needed).
I’m fighting against this budget every step of the way — raising the alarm about the ways it would hurt working people, families, and small businesses, introducing amendments to try to tackle some of the worst components, and urging my GOP colleagues to consider how their constituents will be impacted.
But we need a strong public outcry against this budget if we have any hope of stopping it. Here’s what I’m asking you to do:
1. Pick up the phone and call your Senators at (202) 224-3121 and tell them you oppose budget cuts to programs like Medicaid and Social Security.
2. This is even more critical if you have Republican Senators, because they need to hear loud and clear what the public thinks about their plan.
3. Talk to your friends and neighbors, write letters to the editor, post online — the more people see others speaking out, the more likely they are to join in.
Bottom line: This budget is straight out of Project 2025, hurts everyday people to fund tax breaks for billionaires, and explodes the deficit.
I’m all in to fight back, and if you’re with me, I’d love to know it — please sign on today to say NO to the extreme GOP budget. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/qljIdnL6NEm3hW_H4PUfAw2]
Democrats may be in the minority right now, but that doesn’t mean we get a pass when it comes to fighting back against the dangerous and extreme legislation the GOP is trying to ram through.
Thanks for your support,
Tim Kaine

Derek,

Lara Trump, Donald Trump’s daughter-in-law, recently attacked me on her
right-wing podcast.

She spread the usual lies about my investigation into Trump’s solicitation
of help from Russia and his attempted extortion of President Zelenskyy in
the first impeachment.

This part I found really rich coming from her,
Derek. She said:

“This person oughta be ashamed of himself. I know he’s not, because it
seems as if he doesn’t even have a conscience or any sort of moral
guidance whatsoever.”

Really, Lara, you want to attack me about moral compass?

Where is the moral guidance in your father-in-law slashing funding for
affordable health care for millions of children around the country?

Or slashing support for children and families who would go hungry without
assistance? Or eliminating funding for USAID, which was providing
nutritional support to the poorest parts of the world?

How about the moral guidance of your husband, Eric Trump, and his brother,
Don Jr., opening an exclusive membership club where, for just the low, low
price of $500,000, you can buy unfettered access to high-level Trump
officials? Or their new crypto venture with the gulf states, all to cash
in on the Trump graft?

Or the moral guidance of the modern GOP, which is more focused on tax cuts
for billionaires than lowering costs and providing relief to the millions
of Americans struggling to make ends meet?

Derek, I’m not
losing any sleep over Lara Trump calling me out.

But I won’t let her hypocrisy go unanswered.

I’ll continue to hold the whole Trump family accountable to the rule of
law and the Constitution that their ring-leader, Donald Trump, swore an
oath of office to, but has foresaken.

Friend, Radical Soros-backed prosecutor Aisha Braveboy has launched a political witch-hunt against my police officer son-in-law. That’s a photo of him -- Sgt. Robert Warrington of Bowie, MD -- with his dog, Rooster.

[](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuYHsMbbxgcOyhKhqWnWz7a72hIxtElc4EANJ8-8rEMplDm--N2-e8kPn2keORIEAzs6MCADRFwRw_br7MP_13_fxp3mU8ZX_9GzZwuuG3uAJX7RqTsW7epMtHd_-ff25hkLeyBOfHoN9wltoYr1y3aKKMjI5bQ1OI5sTkQrJRCZ4dM6ZNZIzbVMMDeMZzYgigmsmCbc41RC5HDAwzACAMkJoogUmgmlNpGrbtmUoxWtOorwNTisyTncVQt_7RPc-6vLzNA3j-liFoBqtnoNN1MWafloIBFVnO9MiqEAwzjOjY9VIE6eNobFswMSYKkklZlrzZrlCq3ny9djPQVtEy6Lcx8fdBwK-yN4aN3tEy92PTdHKD8qdLoiWWxdSF-W-PuwOZVV_vv6qvh3q4-6jfv_9coyXsRknG_xqYpDV90CikJvh7rrOjVygFJ_W3kvLWw7_AwAA__9WNpH1)

The day Robert asked for my daughter’s hand in marriage was one of the proudest days of my life. I couldn’t have chosen a better man for my baby girl if I tried. Even though we lost my daughter in 2020 after a long battle with breast cancer, Robert and I have remained close. He’s like a son to me and there’s nothing I won’t do for him. **[That’s why I’m swallowing my pride and asking you, a perfect stranger, for help.](https://email.email.america1stwarroom.com/c/eJw8j0GPmzAQhX-NuYHsMbbxgcOyhKhqWnWz7a72hIxtElc4EANJ8-8rEMplDm--N2-e8kPn2keORIEAzs6MCADRFwRw_br7MP_13_fxp3mU8ZX_9GzZwuuG3uAJX7RqTsW7epMtHd_-ff25hkLeyBOfHoN9wltoYr1y3aKKMjI5bQ1OI5sTkQrJRCZ4dM6ZNZIzbVMMDeMZzYgigmsmCbc41RC5HDAwzACAMkJoogUmgmlNpGrbtmUoxWtOorwNTisyTncVQt_7RPc-6vLzNA3j-liFoBqtnoNN1MWafloIBFVnO9MiqEAwzjOjY9VIE6eNobFswMSYKkklZlrzZrlCq3ny9djPQVtEy6Lcx8fdBwK-yN4aN3tEy92PTdHKD8qdLoiWWxdSF-W-PuwOZVV_vv6qvh3q4-6jfv_9coyXsRknG_xqYpDV90CikJvh7rrOjVygFJ_W3kvLWw7_AwAA__9WNpH1)** Let me tell you what happened so you can decide if you’ll join me in fighting for an innocent man... Last September, Robert stopped to assist a vehicle that appeared to be broken down. As he stepped out of his police car, a man walked right in front of Robert. But when Robert asked if he was with the disabled car, the man did not stop or even acknowledge him. **Then suddenly, the man pivoted to face Robert and stretched his right hand away from his body with a black object in his hand.** If you’ve spent any time around law enforcement officers, then you know they are trained to quickly assess a situation and take necessary action to defend themselves. Robert didn’t know why this car was pulled to the side of the road -- nor did he know who was in it. But he knew that traffic stops are one of the most dangerous situations for a cop to respond to -- so when this man appeared to pull a gun on him, Robert didn’t hesitate. He fired one shot.
